## Collapse

Collapse Group and categorize content, hiding secondary information

### Collapse Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| expandIcon | ReactNode | - | The expand icon |
| triggerRegion | \"icon\" \| \"header\" \| \"disabled\" | - | The region that triggers the collapse |
| active | string \| string[] | - | The currently expanded panel, controlled |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"title\" \| \"extra\" \| \"content\" \| \"icon\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"title\" \| \"extra\" \| \"content\" \| \"icon\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| border | boolean | true | Whether to show the border |
| expandIconPosition | \"left\" \| \"right\" | \"left\" | The position of the expand icon |
| extraPosition | \"left\" \| \"right\" | \"right\" | The position of the extra content |
| children | ReactNode | - | The content inside the collapse |
| animation | boolean | true | Whether to enable collapse animation |
| simple | boolean | false | Simple mode for all items, remove content top/bottom padding and background color |
| defaultActive | string \| string[] | - | The default expanded panel |
| accordion | boolean | false | Whether to enable accordion mode |
| onChange | ((active: string, actives: string[], e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | - | Callback triggered when the expanded panel changes |

### Collapse.Item Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| showExpandIcon | boolean | true | Whether to show the expand icon |
| expandIcon | ReactNode | - | The expand icon |
| extra | ReactNode | - | The extra content |
| title | ReactNode | - | Collapse panel header content |
| contentStyle | CSSProperties | - | Accordion panel content area style |
| simple | boolean | false | Simple mode, remove content top/bottom padding and background color |
| children | ReactNode | - | The content inside the collapse panel |
| **keygen** | string | - | The key of the panel |
| disabled | boolean | false | Whether to disable |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Collapse outermost wrapper element |
| header | Panel header section |
| title | Panel title text |
| extra | Extra content area in header |
| content | Panel expanded content area |
| icon | Expand/collapse icon |

```tsx
<Collapse
  classNames={{ root: 'my-collapse' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础折叠面板，可自定义面板内容
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic collapse, you can customize the content of the panel
 */

import { Collapse } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <div>
      <Collapse defaultActive={['1', '3']} style={{ maxWidth: 1180 }}>
        <Collapse.Item title='This is panel header 1' keygen='0'>
          Joy in living comes from having fine emotions, trusting them, giving them the freedom of a
          bird in the open. Joy in living can never be assumed as a pose, or put on from the outside
          as a mask. People who have this joy do not need to talk about it; they radiate it. They
          just live out their joy and let it splash its sunlight and glow into other lives as
          naturally as bird sings.
        </Collapse.Item>
        <Collapse.Item title='This is panel header 2' keygen='1'>
          Joy in living comes from having fine emotions, trusting them, giving them the freedom of a
          bird in the open. Joy in living can never be assumed as a pose, or put on from the outside
          as a mask. People who have this joy do not need to talk about it; they radiate it. They
          just live out their joy and let it splash its sunlight and glow into other lives as
          naturally as bird sings.
        </Collapse.Item>

        <Collapse.Item title='This is panel header 3' keygen='2' disabled>
          Joy in living comes from having fine emotions, trusting them, giving them the freedom of a
          bird in the open. Joy in living can never be assumed as a pose, or put on from the outside
          as a mask. People who have this joy do not need to talk about it; they radiate it. They
          just live out their joy and let it splash its sunlight and glow into other lives as
          naturally as bird sings.
        </Collapse.Item>

        <Collapse.Item title='This is panel header 4' keygen='3' disabled>
          Joy in living comes from having fine emotions, trusting them, giving them the freedom of a
          bird in the open. Joy in living can never be assumed as a pose, or put on from the outside
          as a mask. People who have this joy do not need to talk about it; they radiate it. They
          just live out their joy and let it splash its sunlight and glow into other lives as
          naturally as bird sings.
        </Collapse.Item>
      </Collapse>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Descriptions

It is generally used to display information on the details page

### Descriptions Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"title\" \| \"extra\" \| \"table\" \| \"label\" \| \"value\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"title\" \| \"extra\" \| \"table\" \| \"label\" \| \"value\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| border | boolean | false | Whether to show the border |
| extra | ReactNode | - | Extended content |
| title | ReactNode | - | The title of the description |
| layout | \"horizontal\" \| \"vertical\" \| \"inlineHorizontal\" \| \"inlineVertical\" | \"inlineHorizontal\" | The layout of the description |
| colon | ReactNode | - | The colon after the label |
| tableLayout | \"auto\" \| \"fixed\" | \"auto\" | The content inside the description |
| items | ItemType[] | - | Descriptions array |
| labelStyle | CSSProperties | - | Label style |
| valueStyle | CSSProperties | - | Value style |
| column | number \| { xs?: number; sm?: number; md?: number; lg?: number; xl?: number; xxl?: number; xxxl?: number; } | 3 | The number of columns placed in each row, one data is one column, it can be configured as a number or an object, when configured as an object format, responsive arrangement is supported |

### ItemType Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | ReactNode | - | Data label |
| value | ReactNode | - | Data value |
| span | number | - | The number of columns occupied |
| itemLabelStyle | CSSProperties | - | The style of the current data label |
| itemValueStyle | CSSProperties | - | The style of the current data value |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Descriptions outermost wrapper element |
| header | Header section container |
| title | Title element |
| extra | Extra content element |
| table | Table element |
| label | Description item label |
| value | Description item value |

```tsx
<Descriptions
  classNames={{ root: 'my-descriptions' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 描述列表的基本样式
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic usage of Descriptions
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Descriptions } from 'shineout';

const data = [
  {
    label: 'Name',
    value: 'Mai Mai',
  },
  {
    label: 'Residence',
    value: 'Beijing',
  },
  {
    label: 'Address',
    value: 'Yingdu Building',
  },
  {
    label: 'Mobile',
    value: '187-2323-9834',
  },
  {
    label: 'Hometown',
    value: 'Beijing',
  },
];

export default () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: '-12px' }}>
      <Descriptions
        items={data}
        title='User Info'
        colon={' :'}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### One Colums

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 单列样式
 *    -- 单列的描述列表样式
 * en - One Colums
 *    -- One colums style of Descriptions
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Descriptions } from 'shineout';

const data = [
  {
    label: 'Name',
    value: 'Mai Mai',
  },
  {
    label: 'Mobile',
    value: '187-2323-9834',
  },
  {
    label: 'Residence',
    value: 'Beijing',
  },
];

export default () => {
  return (
    <>
      <Descriptions
        items={data}
        title='User Info'
        layout='horizontal'
        column={1}
        style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}
      />
      <Descriptions
        items={data}
        title='User Info'
        layout='horizontal'
        column={1}
        labelStyle={{ textAlign: 'end' }}
      />
    </>
  );
};
```

#### Label text alignment

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 标签文本对齐
 *    -- 标签文本可以设置左对齐、右对齐，也可以设置垂直的样式排列
 * en - Label text alignment
 *    -- The label text can be set to left-aligned, right-aligned, and can also be set to vertical style arrangement
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Descriptions } from 'shineout';

const data = [
  {
    label: 'Name',
    value: 'Mai Mai',
  },
  {
    label: 'Residence',
    value: 'Beijing',
  },
  {
    label: 'Address',
    value: 'Yingdu Building',
  },
  {
    label: 'Hometown',
    value: 'Beijing',
  },
  {
    label: 'Mobile',
    value: '187-2323-9834',
  },
];

export default () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: '-12px' }}>
      <Descriptions
        items={data}
        title='User Info'
        layout='horizontal'
        colon={<span style={{ paddingInlineStart: '4px' }}>:</span>}
        style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}
      />
      <Descriptions
        items={data}
        title='User Info'
        layout='horizontal'
        colon={<span style={{ paddingInlineStart: '4px' }}>:</span>}
        labelStyle={{ textAlign: 'end' }}
        style={{ marginBottom: '12px' }}
      />
      <Descriptions
        items={data}
        title='User Info'
        layout='vertical'
        colon={<span style={{ paddingInlineStart: '4px' }}>:</span>}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Empty

Empty Describe

### Empty Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| icon | ReactNode | - | Empty state icon. Enhanced in v3.8.0 to support global configuration via setConfig |
| description | ReactNode \| boolean | - | Description, if false, the description will not be displayed. Enhanced in v3.8.0 to support global configuration via setConfig |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"icon\" \| \"description\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"icon\" \| \"description\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| imgSrc | string | - | Empty state image address, priority is higher than icon |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Empty outermost wrapper element |
| icon | Icon or image container |
| description | Description text |

```tsx
<Empty
  classNames={{ root: 'my-empty' }}
  styles={{ root: { padding: 40 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 空状态组件的基础用法
 * en - Basic
 *    -- The basic usage of Empty
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Empty } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return <Empty></Empty>;
};
```

#### Custom icon and description

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 自定义图标和文案
 *    -- 设置`icon`和`description`属性可以自定义图标和文案
 * en - Custom icon and description
 *    -- Set the `icon` and `description` property to customize the icon and description
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Empty } from 'shineout';
import { customIcon } from './static/icon';

export default () => {
  return <Empty icon={customIcon} description='No network'></Empty>;
};
```

#### Custom image

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 自定义图片
 *    -- 设置`imgSrc`参数传入图片的Url
 * en - Custom image
 *    -- Set the `imgSrc` parameter to the Url of the image
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Empty, Button } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const renderDescription = () => {
    return <Button type='primary'>Refresh</Button>;
  };
  return (
    <Empty
      imgSrc='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sheinsight/shineout-static/main/shineout-next/images/image/s-01.png'
      description={renderDescription()}
    ></Empty>
  );
};
```

## Image

Image Describe

### Image Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| onClick | MouseEventHandler<Element> | - | The callback of click |
| onError | ((e: Event, type: number) => void) | - | Callback of image src or alt request fail |
| placeholder | ReactNode | \"loading | Loading image placeholder content |
| title | string | - | The original property of html |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"img\" \| \"placeholder\" \| \"error\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"img\" \| \"placeholder\" \| \"error\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| renderHoverMask | ((options: {  preview: () => void }) => ReactElement) | - | Custom render hover mask content, options has a preview method, call preview method to preview image |
| fit | \"fill\" \| \"center\" \| \"fit\" \| \"stretch\" | - | Image fill type |
| container | string \| HTMLElement | - | Lazy load container |
| error | ReactNode | - | Custom error content |
| href | string | - | Original picture address |
| lazy | number \| boolean | false | Whether to delay loading, number to set lazy offset |
| inViewOnly | boolean | false | Whether to load only when in view |
| noImgDrag | boolean | false | The original property of html |
| shape | \"rounded\" \| \"circle\" \| \"thumbnail\" | \"rounded\" | Image shape |
| target | \"_self\" \| \"_blank\" \| \"_modal\" \| \"_download\" | \"_modal\" | Target of image |
| width | string \| number | 100% | The width of the image |
| height | string \| number | 100% | The height of the image |
| src | string | - | The picture address |
| alt | string | - | Alternate address, applied when src is invalid |
| autoSSL | boolean | false | Auto transform protocol |

### Image.Group Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| showCount | boolean | - | The number of images to be displayed |
| target | \"_self\" \| \"_blank\" \| \"_modal\" \| \"_download\" | \"_modal\" | Target of image |
| shape | \"rounded\" \| \"circle\" \| \"thumbnail\" | \"rounded\" | Image shape |
| lazy | boolean | false | Whether to delay loading |
| pile | boolean | false | Whether to stack |
| fit | \"fill\" \| \"center\" \| \"fit\" \| \"stretch\" | - | Image fill type |
| width | string \| number | 100% | The width of the image |
| height | string \| number | 100% | The height of the image |
| **children** | ReactNode | - | Children |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Image outermost wrapper element |
| img | Image content (img element or backgroundImage container) |
| placeholder | Loading placeholder area |
| error | Error state area |

```tsx
<Image
  classNames={{ root: 'my-image' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    --基础 Image 用法
 * en - Base
 *    --Base Image
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Image } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <div
      style={{
        gap: 8,
        display: 'flex',
      }}
    >
      <Image
        fit='fill'
        width={128}
        height={128}
        target='_modal'
        src='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sheinsight/shineout-static/main/shineout-next/images/image/s-01.png'
        href='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sheinsight/shineout-static/main/shineout-next/images/image/s-01.png'
      ></Image>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Status

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 不同状态
 *    -- 图片在加载过程中，会有不同的状态。不同状态下的 Image 展现形式不同
 * en - Status
 *    -- Image has different status when loading
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Image, Button } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState(0);
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        onClick={() => {
          setKey(key + 1);
        }}
        style={{marginBottom: 12}}
      >
        reload
      </Button>
      <div
        key={key}
        style={{
          gap: 8,
          display: 'flex',
        }}
      >
        <Image
          fit='fill'
          width={128}
          height={128}
          target='_modal'
          src={`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sheinsight/shineout-static/main/shineout-next/images/image/s-01.png?v=${key}`}
          href={`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sheinsight/shineout-static/main/shineout-next/images/image/s-01.png?v=${key}`}
        />
        <Image fit='fill' width={128} height={128} src='error' />
      </div>
    </>
  );
};
```

#### *    -- Custom rendering of content in different states:

```tsx
/**
 * cn -
 *    -- 支持自定义渲染不同状态下的内容：
 *    -- 1、通过设置 `error` 属性自定义渲染加载失败时的内容
 *    -- 2、通过设置 `placeholder` 属性用于自定义渲染加载中时的占位符内容
 * en -
 *    -- Custom rendering of content in different states:
 *    -- 1. `error` is used to customize the content when loading fails
 *    -- 2. `placeholder` is used to customize the placeholder content when loading
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Image, Button } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState(0);
  const renderIcon = () => {
    return (
      <svg
        width='16'

      >
        <path
          fillRule='evenodd'

          d='M6.67122 2C7.4076 2 8.00456 2.59695 8.00456 3.33333C8.00456 3.50839 7.97008 3.68173 7.90311 3.84347L7.42418 5L8.6665 6.91387L7.18965 9.80933L8.04044 12.2235C8.2852 12.918 7.92059 13.6794 4.43666C10.1177 4.61775 10.1548 4.8074 10.2602 4.96002L11.1278 6.21597C11.2597 6.40688 11.2829 6.65263 11.1889 6.86479L10.8145 7.70933L13.9998 10.1347V4C13.9998 3.63181 13.7014 3.33333 13.3332 3.33333ZM5.69471 3.33333H2.6665C2.29831 3.33333 1.99984 3.63181 1.99984 4V10.0933L4.13693 7.96532C4.40817 7.69516 4.83888 7.6713 5.1383 7.90986L6.03493 8.62424C6.0979 8.67442 6.16629 8.71346 6.23767 8.7416L6.95367 7.33688C7.06186 7.1247 7.04864 6.87093 6.919 6.67114L6.11482 5.43183C5.99536 5.24774 5.97415 5.01664 6.05812 4.81387L6.29761 4.23555C6.43549 3.90258 6.27735 3.52087 5.94438 3.38298C5.86522 3.3502 5.78038 3.33333 5.69471 3.33333ZM3.99984 4C4.73621 4 5.33317 4.59696 5.33317 5.33333C5.33317 6.0697 4.73621 6.66667 3.99984 6.66667C3.26347 6.66667 2.6665 6.0697 2.6665 5.33333C2.6665 4.59696 3.26347 4 3.99984 4ZM3.99984 5.14286C3.89463 5.14286 3.80936 5.22813 3.80936 5.33333C3.80936 5.43854 3.89463 5.52381 3.99984 5.52381C4.10504 5.52381 4.19031 5.43854 4.19031 5.33333C4.19031 5.22813 4.10504 5.14286 3.99984 5.14286Z'
          fill='#B3B7C1'
        />
      </svg>
    );
  };
  const renderError = () => {
    return (
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height: '100%',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          fontSize: 12,
          color: '#666C7C',
        }}
      >
        <div>{renderIcon()}</div>
        <div>Error</div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const renderPlaceholder = () => {
    return (
      <div
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height: '100%',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          fontSize: 12,
          color: '#666C7C',
        }}
      >
        <div>疯狂加载中...</div>
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        onClick={() => {
          setKey(key + 1);
        }}
        style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}
      >
        reload
      </Button>

      <div
        key={key}
        style={{
          gap: 8,
          display: 'flex',
        }}
      >
        <Image
          fit='fill'
          width={128}
          height={128}
          target='_modal'
          placeholder={renderPlaceholder()}
          src={`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sheinsight/shineout-static/main/shineout-next/images/image/s-01.png?v=${key}`}
        />
        <Image fit='fill' width={128} height={128} src='error' error={renderError()} />
      </div>
    </>
  );
};
```

## List

The most basic list display, which can carry text, lists, pictures, paragraphs

### List Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"item\" \| \"footer\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"item\" \| \"footer\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| striped | boolean | - | Whether to display zebra shading. |
| pagination | PaginationProps | PaginationProps | pagination |
| itemStyle | CSSProperties | - | item containter style |
| colNum | number | 1 | Multi-column display |
| **data** | any[] | - | render data |
| **keygen** | \| ObjectKey<DataItem>  \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => string \| number)  \| true | - | Generate a auxiliary method for each key\nIf not filled, index will be used (not recommended, in some cases there may be problems)\nWhen it is a function, use its return value.\nWhen it is a string，ues the value of the string.For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id . |
| renderItem | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((d: DataItem, index: number) => ReactNode) | - | render item |
| fixed | boolean | false | virtualized list |
| dynamicHeight | boolean | false | enable dynamic height virtual list (requires fixed=true) |
| height | number | - | list height |
| bordered | boolean | false | show border |
| lineHeight | number | 32 | height of item |
| rowsInView | number | 10 | Number of list items displayed at the same time |
| empty | ReactNode | - | What to display when no data |
| scrollLoading | (() => void) | - | Triggered when scrolling to the bottom |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | size |
| loading | ReactNode | false | loading |
| loadingPosition | \"center\" \| \"bottom\" | \"center\" | loading icon position, if fixed=true is set, the bottom position is invalid |
| footer | ReactNode \| (() => ReactNode) | - | The content at the bottom |
| rowClassName | string \| ((rowData: DataItem, index: number) => string) | - | custom row className |
| value | any[] | - | The current selected value. |
| onChange | ((value: Value, data: DataItem, checked: boolean) => void) | - | Select the row ,rowData is the selected data, rowIndex is the selected row number. If the data needs to be formatted, it is recommended to configure format |
| prediction | ((value: Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value, data: DataItem) => boolean) | (val, d) => val===format(d) | By default, the result of the format function is used to compare whether it matches. In some cases (for example, whe an object that returns the original data is updated, an different option with the same value  is generated), the prediction function needs to be used to determine whether match |
| disabled | ((data: Item) => boolean) \| boolean | false | When the value is true, disabled all checkboxes; When the value is function, disable the checkbox that this function returns true. |
| format | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem) => Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value) | d => d | Format value. The defaule value is return the original data. When it is a string, the value is fetched from the original data as a key equivalent to (d) => d\\[format] When it is a function, use its return value. |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | List outermost wrapper element |
| item | Each list item |
| footer | Footer content area |

```tsx
<List
  classNames={{ root: 'my-list' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础的列表展示，可承载文字、列表、图片、段落
 * en - Base
 *    -- Basic list display, can carry text, list, image, paragraph
 */
import React from 'react';
import { List } from 'shineout';

const data = [
  'This is a long list of contents',
  'This is a long list of contents',
  'This is a long list of contents',
  'This is a long list of contents',
]

const App: React.FC = () => {
  return <List keygen bordered data={data} />;
};

export default App;
```

#### Size

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 不同尺寸
 *    -- 通过设置 size 为 `large` `small` 分别把按钮设为大、小尺寸。若不设置 size，则尺寸为中
 * en - Size
 *    -- Set size to `large` or `small` to change the size of button
 */
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { List, Radio, TYPE } from 'shineout';

interface ListItem {
  id: number;
  time: string;
  start: string;
  height: number;
  salary: number;
  office: string;
  country: string;
  office5: string;
  position: string;
  lastName: string;
  firstName: string;
}
type ListProps = TYPE.List.Props<ListItem, ListItem>;
type ListData = ListProps['data'];
type ListRenderItem = ListProps['renderItem'];

const data: ListData = [
  {
    id: 1,
    firstName: 'Ephraim',
    lastName: 'Wisozk',
    position: 'Marketing Designer',
    start: '2012-01-29',
    time: '01:42',
    salary: 115777,
    country: 'Reunion',
    office: 'Miami',
    office5: 'Istanbul',
    height: 113.74,
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    firstName: 'Osvaldo',
    lastName: 'Beer',
    position: 'Financial Controller',
    start: '2007-09-04',
    time: '03:26',
    salary: 396093,
    country: 'Syrian Arab Republic',
    office: 'San Paulo',
    office5: 'Shenzhen',
    height: 82.13,
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    firstName: 'Dylan',
    lastName: 'Ratke',
    position: 'Development Lead',
    start: '2009-10-16',
    time: '01:45',
    salary: 236064,
    country: 'Peru',
    office: 'Boston',
    office5: 'Delhi',
    height: 179.53,
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    firstName: 'Shaniya',
    lastName: 'Jacobs',
    position: 'Developer',
    start: '2014-06-30',
    time: '02:17',
    salary: 338985,
    country: 'Peru',
    office: 'Chengdu',
    office5: 'Dallas-Fort Worth',
    height: 190.11,
  },
];

const renderItem: ListRenderItem = (rowData) => (
  <div>{`Name: ${rowData.firstName}-${rowData.lastName}`}</div>
);

const sizeList = ['small', 'default', 'large'];
const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [size, setSize] = useState('default');

  return (
    <>
      <Radio.Group
        style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}
        keygen
        data={sizeList}
        value={size}
        onChange={setSize}
      />
      <List keygen='id' bordered data={data} renderItem={renderItem} size={size as any} />
    </>
  );
};

export default App;
```

## Popover

Usually used for mouse hover display of the operation, as well as general secondary confirmation dialog box bearing

### Popover Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| position | \| \"left-top\"  \| \"left-bottom\"  \| \"right-top\"  \| \"right-bottom\"  \| \"top-right\"  \| \"top-left\"  \| \"bottom-right\"  \| \"bottom-left\"  \| \"left\"  \| \"right\"  \| \"top\"  \| \"bottom\" \| \"auto\" | - | The position of pop-up layer. Default auto |
| priorityDirection | \"auto\" \| \"vertical\" \| \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | Popup location priority, default is top and bottom priority, only valid when position is not set, Options: [\"vertical\", \"horizontal\", \"auto\"] |
| mouseEnterDelay | number | 0 | The show delay of mouseenter(ms) |
| mouseLeaveDelay | number | 0 | The hidden delay of mouseleave (ms) |
| trigger | \"click\" \| \"hover\" | \"hover\" | Trigger mode |
| destroy | boolean | false | Delete dom when close |
| visible | boolean | - | Is visible (controlled) |
| onVisibleChange | ((open: boolean) => void) | - | 显示隐藏改变时事件 |
| onOpen | (() => void) | - | Callback event when open |
| onClose | (() => void) | - | Callback event when close |
| children | ReactNode \| ((close: () => void) => ReactNode) | index | Pop-up content |
| getPopupContainer | (() => HTMLElement \| null) | - | Custom Popover container, override the default behavior which is rendering under the body, () => DOMElement |
| useTextStyle | boolean | - | Using inner styles |
| type | \"info\" \| \"success\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" \| \"error\" | - | 类型 |
| border | string | - | The color of pop-up border(with arrows) |
| background | string | - | Pop-up background-color(with arrows) |
| zIndex | number | 1060 | Z-index of popover |
| showArrow | boolean | true | Show arrow |
| defaultVisible | boolean | - | Whether to display by default |
| clickToCancelDelay | boolean | false | Cancel the popup after clicking the element in mouseEnterDelay |
| scrollDismiss | boolean \| (() => HTMLElement \| null) | false | Scroll to dismiss, return el to order scroller |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"arrow\" \| \"content\", string \| ((info: {  open: boolean, position: \| \"left-top\"  \| \"left-bottom\"  \| \"right-top\"  \| \"right-bottom\"  \| \"top-right\"  \| \"top-left\"  \| \"bottom-right\"  \| \"bottom-left\"  \| \"left\"  \| \"right\"  \| \"top\"  \| \"bottom\" \| \"auto\", type?: \"info\" \| \"success\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" \| \"error\" }) => string)>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames. Allows custom class on internal DOM nodes (root / arrow / content).\nValue can be a static string, or a function that receives the current state snapshot\n(`open`, `position`, `type`) and returns a string dynamically. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"arrow\" \| \"content\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles. Allows inline style on internal DOM nodes (root / arrow / content).\n**Note for `arrow`**: The triangle shape is drawn by the `::before` pseudo-element using\n`clip-path`. Setting `styles.arrow.backgroundColor` on the wrapper div will cover the\ntransparent cutout and break the shape. To change the arrow color, use the `background`\nprop instead — it writes `--popover-background-color` which is consumed by `::before`. |
| offset | [number, number] | [0,0] | The offset value of the width\|height of the pop-up layer, expect the width\|height of the pop-up layer to increase or decrease |
| popupGap | number | 0 | The gap between the pop-up layer and the trigger element |
| disabled | boolean | - | Whether to disable pop-up |
| animation | boolean | true | Whether to enable animation |
| pointAtCenter | boolean | false | Whether the arrow points to the center of the target element (effective for non-center positions like bottom-left, top-right, etc.) |

### Popover.Confirm Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | \"success\" \| \"info\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" \| \"confirmwarning\" \| \"error\" | \"confirmwarning\" | same with [Alert](/components/Alert) type |
| children | ReactNode | - | Pop-up content. |
| text | { ok?: string; cancel?: string; } | { ok: \"Ok\", cancel: \"Cancel\" } | button text |
| onOk | (() => void \| Promise<any>) | - | ok button click callback, will close tooltip while returned promise resolve |
| onCancel | (() => void \| Promise<any>) | - | cancel button click callback, will close tooltip while returned promise resolve |
| okType | \| \"default\"  \| \"primary\"  \| \"secondary\"  \| \"danger\"  \| \"warning\"  \| \"success\"  \| \"link\" | \"danger\" | ok button\"s type, same with [Button](/components/Button) type |
| icon | ReactNode | - | custom icon |
| title | ReactNode | - | title |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Outer wrapper of the popup (equivalent to className) |
| arrow | The small arrow pointing at the trigger element |
| content | The inner content area |

```tsx
<Popover
  classNames={{
    root: 'my-classname'
  }}
  styles={{
    root: {
      color: 'red'
    }
  }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基本的用法，支持鼠标悬浮即显提示文字
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic usage, support mouse hover to show prompt text
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Button, Popover } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <Button mode='outline'>
      Hover
      <Popover>some Text</Popover>
    </Button>
  );
};
```

#### Position

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 弹出位置
 *    -- 内置了十二个弹出的位置
 * en - Position
 *    -- Twelve pop-up positions are built in
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Button, Popover, TYPE } from 'shineout';

type PopoverProps = TYPE.Popover.Props;
type PopoverPosition = PopoverProps['position'];

const positions: Array<PopoverPosition[]> = [
  [undefined, 'bottom-left', 'bottom', 'bottom-right', undefined],
  ['right-top', undefined, undefined, undefined, 'left-top'],
  ['right', undefined, undefined, undefined, 'left'],
  ['right-bottom', undefined, undefined, undefined, 'left-bottom'],
  [undefined, 'top-left', 'top', 'top-right', undefined],
];

const style: React.CSSProperties = {
  margin: 4,
  width: 110,
  display: 'inline-block',
};

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div>
    {positions.map((row, i) => (
      <div key={i}>
        {row.map((p, j) =>
          p ? (
            <Button key={j} mode={'outline'} style={style}>
              <Popover trigger='hover' position={p} useTextStyle>
                <div>i am popover content</div>
                <div>{p}</div>
              </Popover>
              {p}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <div key={j} style={{ ...style, border: 0 }} />
          ),
        )}
      </div>
    ))}
  </div>
);

export default App;
```

#### Trigger

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 点击触发
 *    -- 默认是移入组件触发，设置 trigger 为 'click'，可以改为点击触发
 * en - Trigger
 *    -- Set the trigger property to change the trigger event to 'click'
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Button, Popover } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <Button mode="outline">
    <Popover trigger='click'>hello shineout</Popover>
    Click me
  </Button>
);

export default App;
```

## Skeleton

Skeleton is a placeholder for the page when the real content is not loaded, providing a rough structure of the page.

### Skeleton Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"image\" \| \"text\" \| \"button\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"image\" \| \"text\" \| \"button\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| animation | boolean | - | Whether to enable animation effects |
| loading | boolean | - | Whether to load, when true, show the skeleton screen |
| children | ReactNode | - | Real content |
| text | boolean \| SkeletonTextProps | - | Whether to show text |
| image | boolean \| SkeletonImageProps | - | Whether to show image |
| button | boolean \| SkeletonButtonProps | - | Whether to show button |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Skeleton outermost wrapper element |
| image | Image/avatar placeholder area |
| text | Text lines area |
| button | Button placeholder area |

```tsx
<Skeleton
  classNames={{ root: 'my-skeleton' }}
  styles={{ root: { padding: 16 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
* cn - 基本用法
*    -- 设置 `loading` 为true，开启加载状态
* en - Basic
*    -- Set `loading` to true to enable loading state
 */
import { Skeleton } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <Skeleton loading>
      <div>
        I am the content after loading. I am the content after loading. I am the content after loading.
      </div>
    </Skeleton>
  );
};
```

#### animation

```tsx
/**
* cn - 动画
*    -- 设置 `animation` 为true，开启动画效果
* en - animation
*    -- Set `animation` to true to enable animation
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Skeleton, Switch } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const [animation, setAnimation] = React.useState(true);
  return (
    <>
      <Switch value={animation} onChange={setAnimation} style={{ marginBottom: 24 }} />
      <Skeleton loading animation={animation} text={{ rows: 5, width: '70%' }} image button={{ count: 2 }}>
        <div>
          I am the content after loading. I am the content after loading. I am the content after loading.
        </div>
      </Skeleton>
    </>
  );
};
```

#### Different elements

```tsx
/**
* cn - 不同元素
*    -- 配置不同的 `text`，`image` 和 `button` 属性来渲染不同的元素
* en - Different elements
*    -- Configure different `text`, `image` and `button` properties to render different elements
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Skeleton } from 'shineout';

const style = {
  marginTop: 32,
  marginBottom: 16,
}

export default () => {
  return (
    <div>
      <p style={{marginBottom: 16}}>文本</p>
      <Skeleton loading text={{ rows: 1 }}>I am the content after loading. </Skeleton>

      <p style={style}>段落</p>
      <Skeleton loading text={{ rows: 3, width: '70%' }}>I am the content after loading. </Skeleton>

      <p style={style}>头像</p>
      <Skeleton loading text={false} image={{ size: 'large' }}>I am the content after loading. </Skeleton>

      <p style={style}>图片</p>
      <Skeleton loading text={false} image={{ shape: 'square', size: 'large' }}>I am the content after loading. </Skeleton>

      <p style={style}>按钮</p>
      <Skeleton loading text={false} button>I am the content after loading. </Skeleton>
    </div>
  );
};
```

---

## Spin

The suitable loading animation for pages and sections can effectively reduce user anxiety when waiting for asynchronous data or rendering process.

### Spin Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| tipClassName | string | - | Tip className |
| children | ReactNode | - | Spin has children |
| tip | ReactNode | - | Custom tip |
| size | string \| number | 40 | Size |
| name | \| \"default\"  \| \"chasing-dots\"  \| \"cube-grid\"  \| \"double-bounce\"  \| \"fading-circle\"  \| \"four-dots\"  \| \"plane\"  \| \"pulse\"  \| \"ring\"  \| \"scale-circle\"  \| \"three-bounce\"  \| \"wave\"  \| \"chasing-ring\" | - | Type |
| color | string | - | Color |
| mode | \"vertical\" \| \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | Layout mode |
| loading | boolean | false | Loading |
| ignoreConfig | boolean | false | 内部属性，是否忽略全局配置 |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"section\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"description\", string \| ((info: {  loading: boolean }) => string)>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes (root / section / indicator / description).\nAccepts a static string or a function receiving a state snapshot. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"section\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"description\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM inline styles for internal nodes (root / section / indicator / description). |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Outermost wrapper element |
| section | Loading overlay section (covers children in container mode) |
| indicator | The animated spinner indicator |
| description | The tip/description text |

```tsx
<Spin
  classNames={{ root: 'my-spin-root' }}
  styles={{ root: { opacity: 0.8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础 Spin 用法
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic Spin usage
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Spin } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 20 }}>
      <Spin name="ring" size={16} />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### *    -- Set different animation effects by configuring `name`, and set animation size by configuring `size`

```tsx
/**
 * cn -
 *    -- 通过配置 `name` ，可以设置不同的动画效果, 通过配置 `size` 可以设置动画大小
 * en -
 *    -- Set different animation effects by configuring `name`, and set animation size by configuring `size`
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Spin } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const names1 = [
    // 'default',
    'chasing-dots',
    'cube-grid',
    'double-bounce',
    'fading-circle',
    'four-dots',
    'plane',
  ];

  const names2 = ['pulse', 'ring', 'scale-circle', 'three-bounce', 'wave', 'chasing-ring'];

  const renderTip = (name: string) => {
    return (
      <span style={{ fontSize: 12, lineHeight: '20px', display: 'inline-block' }}>
        {name}
      </span>
    );
  };
  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', overflow: 'auto' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'nowrap', gap: 65, marginBottom: 32 }}>
        {names1.map((name, index) => (
          <div key={index} style={{ width: '16%' }}>
            <Spin name={name as any} size={16} tip={renderTip(name)} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'nowrap', gap: 65 }}>
        {names2.map((name, index) => (
          <div key={index} style={{ width: '16%' }}>
            <Spin key={index} name={name as any} size={16} tip={renderTip(name)} />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 布局模式
 *    -- 在设置 `tip` 文案后，可以通过配置 `mode` 实现不同的布局模式：horizontal 水平布局、vertical 垂直布局
 * en - Basic
 *    -- After setting the `tip` text, you can use the `mode` property to set the layout mode: horizontal or vertical
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Spin } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const renderTip = () => {
    return <span style={{ fontSize: 12 }}>Loading...</span>;
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 24 }}>
      <div style={{ width: 100 }}>
        <Spin name='ring' size={16} mode='vertical' tip={renderTip()} />
      </div>
      <div style={{ width: 100 }}>
        <Spin name='ring' size={16} mode='horizontal' tip={renderTip()} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

---

## Table

Display row and column data for data collection display, analysis and processing

### Table Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"headerRow\" \| \"headerCell\" \| \"bodyRow\" \| \"bodyCell\" \| \"footer\" \| \"footerCell\" \| \"pagination\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"headerRow\" \| \"headerCell\" \| \"bodyRow\" \| \"bodyCell\" \| \"footer\" \| \"footerCell\" \| \"pagination\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| onCellClick | ((data: DataItem, info: { rowIndex: number; columnIndex: number; columnKey: string \| number; }) => void) | - | Cell click event handler. Parameters: data (row data), info.rowIndex (row index), info.columnIndex (column index), info.columnKey (column key) |
| scrollLeft | number | - | Horizontal scroll position (only works with virtual scrolling) |
| rowHeight | number | 40 | Expected height of a single row. Used for virtual scrolling calculations and scrollbar display. |
| hover | boolean | true | Enable row hover highlighting effect |
| empty | ReactNode | getLocale(\"Data not found\") | Content to display when table has no data |
| cellSelectable | boolean | false | Enable cell selection with Ctrl/Cmd + click |
| height | string \| number | - | Table height (same as style.height) |
| onScroll | ((x: number, y: number, left: number, top: number) => void) | - | Scroll event callback. Parameters: x (horizontal scroll ratio 0-1), y (vertical scroll ratio 0-1), left (horizontal scroll pixels), top (vertical scroll pixels) |
| pagination | PaginationProps | - | Pagination configuration. See [Pagination](/components/Pagination) for details |
| loading | ReactNode | false | Loading state. Shows default [Spin](/components/Spin) when true, or custom loading component when provided |
| virtual | boolean \| \"lazy\" | - | Enable virtual scrolling. Set to \"lazy\" to prevent re-rendering during scroll |
| virtualColumn | boolean \| {  overscan?: number } | - | Enable virtual columns (horizontal virtual scrolling). Requires each column to have a width set. Can be boolean or config object with overscan |
| rowsInView | number | 20 | Maximum rows rendered at once. Uses lazy rendering for performance with large datasets. Adjust if displaying more than 20 rows. Set to 0 to render all data. |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | Table size |
| radio | boolean | false | Enable single row selection (radio mode) |
| verticalAlign | \"top\" \| \"middle\" | \"top\" | Vertical alignment of cell content |
| children | ReactNode | - | Native tr/td elements (only applies styles, no functionality) |
| width | string \| number | - | Total table width. Defaults to container width. Must not be less than sum of column widths |
| columns | TableColumn[] | [] | Column configuration array. See TableColumn for details |
| disabled | boolean \| ((d: DataItem) => boolean) | - | Disable rows. When true, disables all rows. When function: parameter d is row data, returns true to disable that row |
| treeEmptyExpand | boolean | false | Show expand button even when tree node has no children |
| rowClickAttr | string \| boolean \| string[] | [\"*\"] | Specify which elements can trigger row click. Use \"*\" to allow any element, or specify attribute names |
| onRowClick | ((rowData: DataItem, index: number, fireAttr?: string \| boolean) => void) | - | Row click event handler. Parameters: rowData (current row data), index (row index), fireAttr (triggered element attribute) |
| striped | boolean | - | Enable alternating row colors (zebra striping) |
| rowClassName | (rowData: DataItem, index: number) => string \| undefined | - | Custom CSS class for each row. Parameters: rowData (row data), index (row index). Returns class name string |
| rowEvents | object | - | Event handlers for tr elements |
| data | object[] | - | Table data array |
| showSelectAll | boolean | true | Show select all checkbox in header |
| bordered | boolean | false | Display table border |
| treeCheckAll | boolean | false | Include all descendant nodes when selecting all (tree mode) |
| renderSorter | ((params: {  status?: \"asc\" \| \"desc\" \| null, triggerAsc: () => void, triggerDesc: () => void }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render function for sort icons. params.status: current sort state (\"asc\"\|\"desc\"\|null), params.triggerAsc: trigger ascending sort, params.triggerDesc: trigger descending sort |
| hideHeader | boolean | false | Hide table header |
| summary | ({  render: () => ReactNode, colSpan?: number, rowSpan?: number })[] \| ({  render: () => ReactNode, colSpan?: number, rowSpan?: number })[][] | - | Table footer for summary rows |
| sticky | boolean \| { top?: number; css?: boolean; target?: Element \| null; } | - | Sticky table header. When true, sticks to top with 0 offset. Can also pass object with top offset and CSS mode options |
| showTopScrollbar | boolean | false | Show horizontal scrollbar at table top |
| showBottomScrollbar | boolean \| BottomScrollbarOption | false | Show sticky horizontal scrollbar at table bottom. Can pass boolean or object with bottom offset and zIndex |
| tableRef | ((table: TableRef) => void) | - | Get table instance reference. Provides methods: scrollToIndex, getRenderIndexByData, scrollColumnIntoView, scrollColumnByLeft, sortByColumn. Use with caution, only supported in virtual mode |
| onRowSelect | ((rows: Value) => void) | - | Row selection callback. Parameter rows contains selected data. Use format and prediction for data formatting |
| cellSortable | boolean | - | Click the cell to trigger sorting |
| strictRowHeight | number | null | Enforce strict row height. When set, all rows will have the same height as specified. Improves performance in virtual mode when row heights are consistent |
| virtualScrollContainer | (() => HTMLElement \| null) | - | External scroll container for virtual scrolling. When set, the table won\"t have internal scroll but will be driven by the external container\"s scroll event. Pass a function that returns the scroll container element (e.g., () => document.body) |
| defaultTreeExpandKeys | (string \| number)[] | - | Default expanded row keys |
| onTreeExpand | ((openKeys: (string \| number)[], data: Item, expand: boolean, index: number) => void) | - | When treeExpandKeys is set, the callback is triggered when the row is expanded. Keys is expanded row key |
| treeExpandKeys | (string \| number)[] | - | Tree Table expanded row keys |
| treeExpandIcon | ((data: Item, index: number, isExpanded: boolean) => ReactNode) | - | Tree Table expand icon |
| expandIcon | ((data: Item, index: number, isExpanded: boolean, expandInstance: ReactNode, clickEvent?: (() => void)) => ReactNode) | - | Table expand icon |
| loader | ((data: Item, index: number) => Promise<void>) | - | Tree Table data loader |
| sorter | ((sortName: string, sorter: \"asc\" \| \"desc\", sortedList: ({  order: \"asc\" \| \"desc\", manual: boolean, key: string \| number, weight?: number })[]) => void \| ((a: Item, b: Item) => number)) | alphaSort(Column.sorter, sorter) | the method of table sort，args are Column.sorter and order\nMulti-column sorting is supported. The sorter passes in the object {rule: string \| function, weight: number}, where rule is a sorting rule, which refers to the use of single-column sorting when it is a string, weight is the weight, indicating the priority of the order\nWhen sorting on multiple columns, sortedList returns information about all fields involved in sorting |
| onSortCancel | ((preType: \"asc\" \| \"desc\", key: string \| number, orders: ({  order: \"asc\" \| \"desc\", weight?: number, key: string \| number, manual: boolean })[], sorter: string) => void) | - | Sort cancel event callback. Triggered when clicking a sorted column to cancel sorting. Parameters: preType (previous sort direction), key (column key), orders (all current sort items), sorter (column sorter name) |
| sortDirections | (\"asc\" \| \"desc\")[] | [\"asc\", \"desc\"] | sort directions |
| columnResizable | boolean | - | Set columnResizable to true to make all columns scalable |
| onColumnResize | (columns: TableColumn[]) => void | - | columns resize callback |
| dataChangeResize | boolean | false | Recalculate columns width while data change |
| expandKeys | (string \| number)[] | - | controlled expand rows |
| **keygen** | \| ObjectKey<DataItem>  \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => string \| number) | - | Generate a auxiliary method for each key\nIf not filled, index will be used (not recommended, in some cases there may be problems)\nWhen it is a function, use its return value.\nWhen it is a string，ues the value of the string.For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id . |
| value | any | - | The current selected value. |
| format | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem) => Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value) | d => d | Format selected value. When string: extracts value using key (e.g., \"id\" extracts d.id). When function: parameter is row data, returns formatted value |
| prediction | ((value: Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value, data: DataItem) => boolean) | (val, d) => val===format(d) | Custom value matching function. Parameters: value (selected value), data (row data). Returns true if matched. Used when default comparison fails (e.g., different object references) |

### columns Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| align | \"left\" \| \"center\" \| \"right\" | \"left\" | Horizontal alignment of cell content |
| colSpan | ((row: DataItem, index: number) => number) | - | Column span control function. Parameters: row (current row data), index (row index). Returns number of columns to merge |
| defaultOrder | \"asc\" \| \"desc\" | - | Default sort order for this column |
| fixed | \"left\" \| \"right\" | - | Fix column to left or right. For multiple adjacent fixed columns, only specify the outermost one |
| group | ReactNode \| ReactNode[] | - | Header group name. Adjacent columns with the same group will be merged into one header |
| groupProps | { className?: string; style?: CSSProperties; } | - | Additional props for header group (className, style) |
| hide | boolean | - | Hide column (only works for row-expand type columns) |
| key | string \| number | - | Unique key for column. Defaults to column index if not provided |
| minWidth | number | - | Minimum column width |
| maxWidth | number | - | Maximum column width (when resizing) |
| filterAll | ((data: DataItem[]) => DataItem[]) | - | Filter function for select all. Only works when type=\"checkbox\". Parameter: data array. Returns filtered data |
| render | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| function(d, id, instance) | - | Render cell content. Can be property key string (e.g., \"name\" renders row.name) or function with parameters: data (row data), index (row index), checkboxInstance (when type=\"checkbox\") |
| rowSpan | ((prevRowData: DataItem, nextRowData: DataItem) => boolean) | - | Row merge control function. Parameters: prevRowData, nextRowData (adjacent rows). Returns true to merge rows |
| sorter | string \| ((order: \"asc\" \| \"desc\") => void \| ((prevRowData: DataItem, nextRowData: DataItem) => number)) \| {  rule: string \| ((sorter: ({  order: \"asc\" \| \"desc\", manual: boolean, key: string \| number, weight?: number })[]) => void), weight: number } | - | Sort configuration. Can be string (sort field name), sort function, or Sorter object with rule and weight. When provided, sort icon appears in column header |
| sortDirections | (\"asc\" \| \"desc\")[] | [\"asc\", \"desc\"] | Available sort directions for this column |
| filter | \| SelectModeColumnFilter<DataItem>  \| SearchModeColumnFilter<DataItem> | - | Column filter configuration. Supports search and select modes |
| title | ReactNode \| ((rowData: DataItem[]) => ReactNode) | - | Column header content. Can be string, ReactNode, or function that receives all data |
| treeColumnsName | ObjectKey<DataItem> | - | Property name for tree children data |
| treeIndent | number | 25 | Indentation width for each tree level (in pixels) |
| type | \"expand\" \| \"row-expand\" \| \"checkbox\" | - | Special column type. \"expand\": Row expand column, render returns function for expandable content. \"row-expand\": Like expand but clicking anywhere in row triggers expand. \"checkbox\": Selection column |
| width | string \| number | - | Column width |
| className | string | - | CSS class name for this column |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Inline styles for table cells in this column |
| onClick | ((d: DataItem, isExpand: boolean) => void) | - | Click event for expandable element. Only works when column type is \"expand\" or \"row-expand\" and expandKeys prop is provided. Parameters: data (row data), isExpand (expand state) |
| columnResizable | false | - | Disable column resizing for this specific column |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Table outermost wrapper element |
| header | Table header wrapper (only in sticky/virtual mode) |
| headerRow | Table header row (tr element) |
| headerCell | Table header cell (th element) |
| bodyRow | Table body row (tr element) |
| bodyCell | Table body cell (td element) |
| footer | Table footer wrapper (only in sticky/virtual mode) |
| footerCell | Table footer cell (td element) |
| pagination | Pagination wrapper |

```tsx
<Table
  classNames={{ root: 'my-table' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础的表格用法。推荐 `columns` 写为常量，以提升性能
 * en - Base
 *    -- Basic table usage
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Table, TYPE } from 'shineout';

interface TableRowData {
  id: number;
  time: string;
  start: string;
  height: number;
  salary: number;
  office: string;
  country: string;
  office5: string;
  position: string;
  lastName: string;
  firstName: string;
}

type TableColumnItem = TYPE.Table.ColumnItem<TableRowData>;

const data: TableRowData[] = [
  {
    id: 1,
    firstName: 'Ephraim',
    lastName: 'Wisozk',
    position: 'Marketing Designer',
    start: '2012-01-29',
    time: '01:42',
    salary: 115777,
    country: 'Reunion',
    office: 'Miami',
    office5: 'Istanbul',
    height: 113.74,
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    firstName: 'Osvaldo',
    lastName: 'Beer',
    position: 'Financial Controller',
    start: '2007-09-04',
    time: '03:26',
    salary: 396093,
    country: 'Syrian Arab Republic',
    office: 'San Paulo',
    office5: 'Shenzhen',
    height: 82.13,
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    firstName: 'Dylan',
    lastName: 'Ratke',
    position: 'Development Lead',
    start: '2009-10-16',
    time: '01:45',
    salary: 236064,
    country: 'Peru',
    office: 'Boston',
    office5: 'Delhi',
    height: 179.53,
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    firstName: 'Shaniya',
    lastName: 'Jacobs',
    position: 'Developer',
    start: '2014-06-30',
    time: '02:17',
    salary: 338985,
    country: 'Peru',
    office: 'Chengdu',
    office5: 'Dallas-Fort Worth',
    height: 190.11,
  },
];

const columns: TableColumnItem[] = [
  { title: 'Name', render: (d) => `${d.firstName} ${d.lastName}` },
  { title: 'Country', render: 'country' },
  { title: 'Position', render: 'position' },
  { title: 'Office', render: 'office' },
];

export default () => {
  return (
    <div>
      <Table keygen='id' columns={columns} data={data} />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Empty

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 空状态
 *    -- 表格空状态
 * en - Empty
 *    -- Table empty state
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Table, TYPE } from 'shineout';

interface TableRowData {
  id: number;
  time: string;
  start: string;
  height: number;
  salary: number;
  office: string;
  country: string;
  office5: string;
  position: string;
  lastName: string;
  firstName: string;
}

type TableColumnItem = TYPE.Table.ColumnItem<TableRowData>;

const columns: TableColumnItem[] = [
  { title: 'Name', render: (d) => `${d.firstName} ${d.lastName}` },
  { title: 'Country', render: 'country' },
  { title: 'Position', render: 'position' },
  { title: 'Office', render: 'office' },
];

export default () => {
  return (
    <div>
      <Table keygen='id' columns={columns} data={[]} />
    </div>
  );
};
```

    id: 2,

---

## Tabs

This component is used to separate sets of data related to each other but belonging to different categories, and it serves as a global navigation.

### Tabs Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"tab\" \| \"panel\" \| \"extra\" \| \"ink\" \| \"prev\" \| \"next\" \| \"collapsible\" \| \"inner\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"tab\" \| \"panel\" \| \"extra\" \| \"ink\" \| \"prev\" \| \"next\" \| \"collapsible\" \| \"inner\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| lazy | boolean | true | Whether to enable lazy loading |
| shape | \"button\" \| \"line\" \| \"bordered\" \| \"card\" \| \"dash\" \| \"fill\" | \"card\" | When Shape is not empty, color parameters such as activeBackground will be invalid. When shape is bordered, it points to card |
| children | ReactNode | - | Child element, must be a Panel element |
| extra | ReactNode | - | Extra content |
| splitColor | string | - | Split line color, replace the original border property |
| hideSplit | boolean | - | Whether to hide the split line |
| collapsible | boolean | - | Whether can be collapsed |
| defaultCollapsed | boolean | - | Default collapse state, effective when collapsible is set to true |
| autoFill | boolean | - | Auto fill the panel, when the position is left-top, right-top and the shape is not button and fill, it is enabled by default, and other cases need to be controlled manually |
| switchToTop | boolean | - | Switch tabs will scroll to Tabs |
| sticky | number \| boolean \| StickyProps | - | Sticky header |
| position | \| \"top-left\"  \| \"top-right\"  \| \"bottom-left\"  \| \"bottom-right\"  \| \"left-top\"  \| \"left-bottom\"  \| \"right-top\"  \| \"right-bottom\" | - | The position of the tab |
| activeBackground | string | - | Active background color |
| inactiveBackground | string | - | Inactive background color |
| tabBarStyle | CSSProperties | - | Style in tab bar |
| onChange | ((key: string \| number) => void) | - | Change callback |
| color | string | - | The color of tab\"s text only when the shape is \"card\" |
| allowNonPanel | boolean | - | Allow non-Tabs.Panel children |
| renderTabsHeader | ((header: ReactNode, props: Omit<TabsProps, \"renderTabsHeader\">) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render header content |
| active | string \| number | - | Current active tab id or index |
| defaultActive | string \| number | 0 | Default active tab id or index |

### Tabs.Panel Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| activeBackground | string | - | Background color, will override Tabs\"s activeBackground |
| color | string | - | The color of tab\"s text only when the shape is \"card\" |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| id | string \| number | - | The default is index |
| **tab** | ReactNode | index | Tab content |
| disabled | boolean | false | Specifies the Panel should be disabled |
| children | ReactNode | - | Panel content |
| splitColor | string | - | The color of the dividing line, only takes effect when shape=line |
| background | string | - | Background color, will override Tabs background |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Tabs outermost wrapper element |
| header | Tab bar header area |
| tab | Each tab item |
| panel | Content panel area |
| extra | Extra content area |
| ink | Ink bar indicator (line/dash shape) |
| prev | Previous scroll button |
| next | Next scroll button |
| collapsible | Collapsible button |

```tsx
<Tabs
  classNames={{ root: 'my-tabs' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 选项卡的基本用法
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic usage of Tabs
 */
import { Tabs } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const tabs = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    tabs.push({ title: `Tab ${i + 1}`, content: `Content of Tab ${i + 1}` });
  }
  return (
    <div style={{ height: 100 }}>
      <Tabs shape='line' defaultActive={0}>
        {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
          return (
            <Tabs.Panel key={index} tab={tab.title}>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, height: '100%', fontSize: 14 }}>{tab.content}</div>
            </Tabs.Panel>
          );
        })}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Shape

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 不同样式
 *    -- 选项卡有五种样式，可通过 `shape` 属性设置，card 卡片，line 线条，button 按钮, fill 填充, dash 短线
 *    -- 设置 `shape = "line"` 标签页显示为线条
 * en - Shape
 *    -- There are three shapes for tabs, you can set the `shape` property to change it
 *    -- Set `shape = "line"` to show tabs as line
 */
import { Tabs } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const tabs: any[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    tabs.push({ title: `Tab ${i + 1}`, content: `Content of Tab ${i + 1}` });
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ height: 100 }}>
      <Tabs shape={'line'} defaultActive={0}>
        {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
          return (
            <Tabs.Panel key={index} tab={tab.title}>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, height: '100%', fontSize: 14 }}>{tab.content}</div>
            </Tabs.Panel>
          );
        })}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### *    -- Set `shape = "button"` to show tabs as buttons

```tsx
/**
 * cn -
 *    -- 设置 `shape = "button"` 标签页显示为按钮
 * en -
 *    -- Set `shape = "button"` to show tabs as buttons
 */
import { Tabs } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const tabs: any[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    tabs.push({ title: `Tab ${i + 1}`, content: `Content of Tab ${i + 1}` });
  }

  return (
    <div style={{ height: 100 }}>
      <Tabs shape={'button'} defaultActive={0}>
        {tabs.map((tab, index) => {
          return (
            <Tabs.Panel key={index} tab={tab.title}>
              <div style={{ padding: 16, height: '100%', fontSize: 14 }}>{tab.content}</div>
            </Tabs.Panel>
          );
        })}
      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Tag

Tag is a flexible and commonly used classification method for tagging, categorizing, or selecting keywords.

### Tag Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"wrapper\" \| \"closeIcon\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"wrapper\" \| \"closeIcon\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| mode | \"bright\" \| \"outline\" \| \"fill\" \| \"brightOutline\" | \"bright\" | Tag style |
| disabled | boolean | false | Is disabled |
| color | \| \"default\"  \| \"info\"  \| \"success\"  \| \"warning\"  \| \"danger\"  \| \"brown\"  \| \"purple\"  \| \"cyan\"  \| \"magenta\"  \| \"indigo\"  \| \"tangerine\"  \| \"lemon\"  \| \"neon\"  \| \"orange\" | \"default\" | Tag color, replace the original type attribute, support more color system |
| shape | \"rounded\" | \"default\" | Tag shape |
| backgroundColor | string | - | Background color,can set the tag\"s background color by it |
| children | ReactNode | - | Tag content, text or react component |
| onCompleted | ((value: string) => void) | - | This event is triggered when Tag editing is completed (children must be string) |
| onClick | ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | - | The click callback |
| onClose | boolean \| ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => void \| Promise<any>) | - | When onClose is empty, no close is displayed. If you need to close and do not need to handle callbacks, set it true |
| onKeyUp | ((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void) | - | Editable input box keyUp event |
| onEnterPress | ((value: string, e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void) | - | Editable input box enter event |

### Tag.Input Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| onKeyUp | ((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void) | - | KeyUp event callback |
| onEnterPress | ((value: string, e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void) | - | EnterPress change callback |
| onFocus | ((e: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement, Element>) => void) | - | Focus event callback |
| onBlur | ((value: string, e: FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement, Element>) => void) | - | Blur event callback |
| onChange | ((value?: string) => void) | - | Value change callback |
| value | string | - | In control |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Tag outermost wrapper element |
| wrapper | Content wrapper area |
| closeIcon | Close icon button |

```tsx
<Tag
  classNames={{ root: 'my-tag' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 标签常用的 5 种基本功能，默认、信息、危险、警告、成功
 *    -- 注意，`type` 属性将弃用，请使用 `color` 属性
 * en - Base
 *    -- The five basic functions of the tag, default, info, danger, warning, success
 *   -- Note that the `type` property will be deprecated, please use the `color` property
 */

import { Tag } from 'shineout';
export default () => {
  const TagColor = ['default', 'info', 'danger', 'warning', 'success'];

  const capitalizeFirstLetter = (str: string) => {
    return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
  };
  return (
    <div>
      {TagColor.map((item, index) => (
        <Tag key={index} color={item as any}>
          {capitalizeFirstLetter(item)}
        </Tag>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Size

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 标签尺寸
 *    -- 标签尺寸分为 小、中、大 3 种
 * en - Size
 *    -- The size of the tag is divided into small, default and large
 */

import { Tag } from 'shineout';
export default () => {
  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <Tag size='small'>Small</Tag>
        <Tag>Default</Tag>
        <Tag size='large'>Large</Tag>
      </div>
      <div>
        <Tag size='small' onClose>
          Small
        </Tag>
        <Tag onClose>Default</Tag>
        <Tag size='large' onClose>
          Large
        </Tag>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Mode

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 标签样式
 *    -- 标签样式分为 亮色、填充、线框、亮色线框 4 种
 * en - Mode
 *    -- The mode of the tag is divided into bright, fill, outline, brightOutline line 4 kinds
 */

import { Tag } from 'shineout';
export default () => {
  const TagColor = ['default', 'info', 'danger', 'warning', 'success'];
  const TagMode = ['bright', 'fill', 'outline', 'brightOutline'];

  const capitalizeFirstLetter = (str: string) => {
    return str.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + str.slice(1);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {TagMode.map((mode, midx) => {
        return (
          <div key={midx} style={{ marginBottom: midx === TagMode.length - 1 ? 0 : 24 }}>
            {TagColor.map((color, cidx) => (
              <Tag mode={mode as any} key={cidx} color={color as any}>
                {capitalizeFirstLetter(color)}
              </Tag>
            ))}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Tooltip

Tooltip is a small pop-up box that appears when a user pauses the pointer over an element, or clicks on it.

### Tooltip Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| trigger | \"hover\" \| \"click\" \| \"focus\" | \"hover\" | Pop-up type |
| position | \| \"left-top\"  \| \"left-bottom\"  \| \"right-top\"  \| \"right-bottom\"  \| \"top-right\"  \| \"top-left\"  \| \"bottom-right\"  \| \"bottom-left\"  \| \"left\"  \| \"right\"  \| \"top\"  \| \"bottom\" \| \"auto\" | \"auto\" | The position of the pop-up layer |
| priorityDirection | \"auto\" \| \"vertical\" \| \"horizontal\" | \"vertical\" | Popup location priority, default is left and right priority, only valid when position is not set |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| mouseEnterDelay | number | 0 | Pop-up delay, default is 0 no delay, unit is milliseconds. |
| mouseLeaveDelay | number | 0 | The hidden delay of mouseleave (ms) |
| **children** | ReactNode | - | The child element can only be a ReactElement. |
| disabledChild | boolean | false | make disabled element work |
| **tip** | ReactNode | - | Pop up texts |
| type | \"default\" \| \"light\" \| \"primary\" \| \"success\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" | default | style |
| zIndex | number | 1051 | Z-index of popover |
| persistent | boolean | false | Whether to keep the tooltip content displayed when hovering over the tooltip content |
| showArrow | boolean | true | Whether to show the arrow |
| popupGap | number | - | Popup gap |
| pointAtCenter | boolean | false | Whether the arrow points to the center of the target element (effective for non-center positions like bottom-left, top-right, etc.) |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"arrow\" \| \"content\", string \| ((info: {  open: boolean, position: \| \"left-top\"  \| \"left-bottom\"  \| \"right-top\"  \| \"right-bottom\"  \| \"top-right\"  \| \"top-left\"  \| \"bottom-right\"  \| \"bottom-left\"  \| \"left\"  \| \"right\"  \| \"top\"  \| \"bottom\" \| \"auto\", type?: \"default\" \| \"light\" \| \"primary\" \| \"success\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" }) => string)>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes (root / arrow / content).\nAccepts a static string or a function receiving a state snapshot. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"arrow\" \| \"content\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM inline styles for internal nodes (root / arrow / content). |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Outer wrapper of the tooltip popup (equivalent to className) |
| arrow | The small arrow pointing at the trigger element |
| content | The inner content area |

```tsx
<Tooltip
  tip="hello"
  classNames={{
    root: 'my-classname'
  }}
  styles={{
    root: {
      color: 'red'
    }
  }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- children 只能为一个 ReactElement 并且不可以使用 Fragment
 *    -- 内置了四个弹出方向
 * en - Base
 *    -- children can only be a ReactElement and cannot be a Fragment
 *    -- There are four pop-up directions built in
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Tooltip, Button } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div>
    <Tooltip tip='hello world' trigger='hover'>
      <Button type='primary'>hover me</Button>
    </Tooltip>
  </div>
);
export default App;
```

#### Position

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 弹出位置
 *    -- 内置了十二个弹出的位置
 * en - Position
 *    -- Twelve pop-up positions are built in
 *
 */

import React from 'react';
import { Button, Tooltip, TYPE } from 'shineout';

type PopoverProps = TYPE.Popover.Props;
type PopoverPosition = PopoverProps['position'];

const positions: Array<PopoverPosition[]> = [
  [undefined, 'bottom-left', 'bottom', 'bottom-right', undefined],
  ['right-top', undefined, undefined, undefined, 'left-top'],
  ['right', undefined, undefined, undefined, 'left'],
  ['right-bottom', undefined, undefined, undefined, 'left-bottom'],
  [undefined, 'top-left', 'top', 'top-right', undefined],
];

const style: React.CSSProperties = {
  margin: 4,
  width: 110,
  display: 'inline-block',
};

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div>
    {positions.map((row, i) => (
      <div key={i}>
        {row.map((p, j) =>
          p ? (
            <Tooltip
              key={j}
              position={p}
              tip={
                <div>
                  <div>i am popover content</div>
                  <div>{p}</div>
                </div>
              }
            >
              <Button key={j} mode={'outline'} style={style}>
                {p}
              </Button>
            </Tooltip>
          ) : (
            <div key={j} style={{ ...style, border: 0 }} />
          ),
        )}
      </div>
    ))}
  </div>
);

export default App;
```

#### Click

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 点击触发
 *    -- 默认触发事件为 hover，如果需要点击触发，可以设置 `trigger` 为 'click'
 * en - Click
 *    -- Set the trigger property to change the `trigger` event to 'click'
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Tooltip, Button } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div>
    <Tooltip tip='Some text.' trigger='click'>
      <Button type='primary'>click me</Button>
    </Tooltip>
  </div>
);
export default App;
```
