## Tree

Tree Describe

### Tree Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| tiledData | DataItem[] | - |  |
| active | string \| number | - | Active node key |
| value | Value | - | The keys of selected |
| defaultValue | (string \| number)[] | - | Default selected key (not controlled) |
| **data** | DataItem[] | - | Data, children is children, if children is null or length is 0, it is considered as a leaf node |
| expanded | (string \| number)[] | - | Expanded node |
| defaultExpanded | (string \| number)[] | - | Default expanded nodes |
| defaultExpandAll | boolean | false | Expanded all nodes |
| disabled | boolean \| ((item: DataItem) => boolean) \| {  disabled: (data: DataItem) => boolean, isRealtime: boolean } | false | Control whether the node can be chosen |
| **keygen** | \| ObjectKey<DataItem>  \| ((data: DataItem, index: string) => string \| number) | index | Auxiliary method for generating key. When it is a function, use the return value of this function. When it is a string, use the data value corresponding to this string. For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id |
| childrenKey | ObjectKey<DataItem> | \"children\" | Specify the name of the subdata |
| mode | 0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 | 1 | Mode 0: Returns only the fully selected node including the parent node. 1: Returns all selected nodes and semi-selected nodes. 2: Return only the selected child nodes. 3: If the parent node is full selected, only return the parent node. 4: What you choose is what you get |
| dataUpdate | boolean | true | Whether to monitor data changes to update data |
| unmatch | boolean | - | Whether to enable unmatch mode |
| onExpand | ((value: (string \| number)[]) => void) | - | Expand event |
| sortBySelect | boolean | false | When enabled in multi-select mode, the value array is sorted by selection order instead of tree structure order |
| virtual | boolean | - | Virtual list |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"node\" \| \"content\" \| \"icon\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"node\" \| \"content\" \| \"icon\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| line | boolean | true | Whether show line |
| iconClass | string | - | Class name of icon |
| nodeClass | string \| ((data: DataItem) => string) | - | Class name of node |
| contentClass | string \| ((data: DataItem) => string) | - | Class name of content |
| leafClass | string \| ((data: DataItem) => string) | - | The class of leaf, the params of function is data |
| leafIcon | boolean \| ((d: T) => ReactNode) \| ReactNode | - | The class of checkbox, the params of function is data |
| expandIcons | (ReactNode \| ((d: DataItem) => ReactNode))[] | - | Custom expand/collapse buttons |
| childrenClass | string \| ((data: DataItem) => string) | - | The class of children, the params of function is data |
| onDrop | ((data: DataItem[], key: string \| number, targetKey: string \| number, position: number) => void) | - | When setting the onDrop attribute, it is draggable |
| setActive | ((key: string \| number, data?: DataItem) => void) | - | Set active node key |
| doubleClickExpand | boolean | false | If need to double-click to expand |
| parentClickExpand | boolean | false | Expand by click parent node |
| actionOnClick | ActionOnClick \| ActionOnClick[] | - | The operation when clicking the node to expand: \"expand\" expand the node, \"check\" check the checkbox |
| dragImageSelector | string \| ((data?: DataItem) => string) | - | Selector when dray image |
| **renderItem** | \| ((item: DataItem, expanded: boolean, active: boolean, id: string \| number) => ReactNode)  \| ObjectKey<DataItem> | index | When it is a string, return d[string]. When it is a function, return the result of the function |
| onChange | ((value: Value, id: string \| number) => void) | - | Change event |
| dragImageStyle | CSSProperties | - | Dom style when drop images |
| dragSibling | boolean | - | Whether it can only be dragged at the same level |
| dragHoverExpand | boolean | false | Automatically expand nodes with child nodes when dragging |
| inlineNode | boolean | false | Whether the node is inline |
| highlight | boolean | true | Whether to highlight the node when clicked |
| loader | ((key: string \| number, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Dynamically load nodes |
| onClick | ((data: DataItem, id: string \| number, path?: {  children: (string \| number)[], path: (string \| number)[], isDisabled: boolean, indexPath: number[], index: number }) => void) | - | Click event |
| onDragStart | ((e: DragEvent<Element>, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Drag start event |
| onDragEnd | ((e: DragEvent<Element>, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Drag end event |
| onDragOver | ((e: DragEvent<Element>, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Drag over event |
| onDragLeave | ((e: DragEvent<Element>, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Drag leave event |
| lineHeight | number | - | The height of the list item |
| height | number | - | Height of the list, only effective when virtual is opened |
| rowsInView | number | 20 | Number of list items displayed at the same time |
| rootStyle | CSSProperties | - |  |
| ignoreSetFlat | boolean | - |  |
| size | \"small\" \| \"default\" \| \"large\" | default | size of Tree |
| filteredData | DataItem[] | - | Filtered data is passed in, but the check is still based on data |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Tree outermost wrapper element |
| node | Each tree node wrapper |
| content | Node content area (includes checkbox and text) |
| icon | Expand/collapse icon |

```tsx
<Tree
  classNames={{ root: 'my-tree' }}
  styles={{ root: { border: '1px solid #eee' } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础 Tree 组件用法，当配置 `children` 字段时，允许展开和收起节点
 * en - Base
 *    -- Basic usage of Tree component. When the `children` field is configured, it allows expanding and collapsing nodes
 */

import { Tree, TYPE } from 'shineout';
type TreeProps = TYPE.Tree.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

interface DataItem {
  id: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

export default () => {
  const data = [
    {
      id: '0',
      children: [
        {
          id: '0-0',
          children: [
            {
              id: '0-0-0',
            },
            {
              id: '0-0-1',
              children: [
                {
                  id: '0-0-1-0',
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          id: '0-1',
          children: [
            {
              id: '0-1-0',
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: '1',
      children: [
        {
          id: '1-0',
          children: [
            {
              id: '1-0-0',
            },
            {
              id: '1-0-1',
              children: [
                {
                  id: '1-0-1-0',
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          id: '1-1',
          children: [
            {
              id: '1-1-0',
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];

  const renderItem: TreeProps['renderItem'] = (node) => {
    return `node ${node.id}`;
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <Tree data={data} keygen='id' renderItem={renderItem}></Tree>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### line

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 无连接线
 *    -- 设置 `line` 为 false，不显示连接线
 * en - line
 *    -- Set `line` to false to hide the connection line
 */

import { Tree, TYPE } from 'shineout';
type TreeProps = TYPE.Tree.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

interface DataItem {
  id: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

export default () => {
  const data: DataItem[] = [
    {
      id: '0',
      children: [
        {
          id: '0-0',
          children: [
            {
              id: '0-0-0',
              children: [
                {
                  id: '0-0-0-0',
                },
              ],
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          id: '0-1',
          children: [
            {
              id: '0-1-0',
            },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];

  const renderItem: TreeProps['renderItem'] = (node: any) => {
    return <span style={{ display: 'inline-block' }}>{`node ${node.id}`}</span>;
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <Tree
        defaultExpanded={['0', '0-0']}
        line={false}
        data={data}
        keygen='id'
        renderItem={renderItem}
      ></Tree>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### expand

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 控制展开
 *    -- 基础 Tree 组件用法，当配置 `children` 字段时，允许展开和收起节点
 * en - expand
 *    -- Basic usage of Tree component. When the `children` field is configured, it allows expanding and collapsing nodes
 *
 */
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Tree, Button, TYPE } from 'shineout';
import { createNestedArray, getIds } from './utils';

type TreeProps = TYPE.Tree.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

interface DataItem {
  id: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

const data: DataItem[] = createNestedArray([2, 2, 2]);

export default () => {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<TreeProps['expanded']>([]);

  const renderItem: TreeProps['renderItem'] = (node) => {
    return <span style={{ display: 'inline-block' }}>{`node ${node.id}`}</span>;
  };

  const handleExpandAll = () => {
    setExpanded(getIds(data));
  };

  const handleCloseAll = () => {
    setExpanded([]);
  };

  const handleExpand: TreeProps['onExpand'] = (ids) => {
    setExpanded([...ids]);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <div style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}>
        <Button size='small' mode='outline' type='secondary' onClick={handleExpandAll}>
          Expand all
        </Button>
        <Button size='small' mode='outline' type='secondary' onClick={handleCloseAll}>
          Collapse all
        </Button>
      </div>
      <Tree
        line={false}
        data={data}
        expanded={expanded}
        onExpand={handleExpand}
        keygen='id'
        renderItem={renderItem}
      ></Tree>
    </div>
  );
};
```

---

## Cascader

For related datasets, a cascading selection method can be used for multi-level classification.

### Cascader Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| status | \"error\" | - | The status of the component |
| innerTitle | ReactNode | - | inner title |
| filterSameChange | boolean | false | onChange is not triggered when two selected values are the same |
| absolute | boolean \| (() => HTMLElement \| null) | false | When it is true, the pop-up layer of option append into document.body; When it is a function, the return value is used as the popup layer container |
| zIndex | number | 1000 | options z-index should use with absolute |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"popup\" \| \"list\" \| \"option\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"popup\" \| \"list\" \| \"option\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| multiple | boolean | false | Open multiple selection |
| mode | 0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 | - | Mode 0: Returns only the fully selected node including the parent node. 1: Returns all selected nodes and semi-selected nodes. 2: Return only the selected child nodes. 3: If the parent node is full selected, only return the parent node. 4: What you choose is what you get |
| sortBySelect | boolean | false | When enabled in multi-select mode, the value array is sorted by selection order instead of tree structure order |
| width | string \| number | - | Input width |
| open | boolean | - | Set visible of cascader popup |
| value | Value | - | Selected key (controlled). Note: Do not use undefined and null as meaningful option values. When the value type is undefined and null, the component will not process data and rendering |
| defaultValue | Value | - | Selected key |
| data | any[] | - | data. The child node is children. If the children value is null or its length is 0, it is render as a leaf node |
| childrenKey | ObjectKey<DataItem> | \"children\" | the key of the children data name |
| final | boolean | - | Only the last node can be selected |
| filterDelay | number | \"children\" | The delay in milliseconds before the filter event is triggered by user input. |
| renderOptionList | ((list: ReactElement, info: { loading: boolean; }) => ReactElement) | - | Custom render dropdown |
| renderUnmatched | ((data: any) => ReactNode) | - | Custom rendering unmatched values |
| height | number \| \"auto\" | 300 | height of dropdown options |
| unmatch | boolean | true | render unmatch value |
| clearable | boolean | true | If clearable is true, show clear value icon |
| wideMatch | boolean | false | Allows all possible matching options to be choosed |
| showArrow | boolean | true | show dropdown arrow, only single select |
| finalDismiss | boolean | false | close options after chose the final node |
| singleRemove | boolean | - | Support single node deletion |
| compressedBound | number | - | when compressed is True,the comptessedBound can limit the numbers of multiple selected item\"s label |
| loading | boolean \| ReactNode | - | dropdown list loading state |
| compressed | boolean \| \"no-repeat\" \| \"hide-popover\" | false | Merges selected values; the repeat value will not appear in the Popover when it is\"no-repeat\" |
| renderCompressed | ((options: {  data: DataItem[], onRemove: (item: DataItem) => void }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render compressed content |
| onCollapse | ((collapse: boolean) => void) | - | options collapse callback |
| loader | ((key: string \| number, data: DataItem) => void) | - | If the loader attribute is a function, the node with no children is regarded as dynamically loaded node. Click expanded button to trigger the loader event. The children property is null or its length is 0 will be regarded as a leaf node. |
| disabled | boolean \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean) \| {  disabled: (data: DataItem) => boolean, isRealtime: boolean } | false | When disabled is true, the entire selection box is disabled. If disabled is a function, the option is disabled according to the return result of the function. For performance reasons, by default, disabled |
| expandTrigger | \"click\" \| \"hover\" \| \"hover-only\" | \"click\" | Expand mode |
| onChange | ((value: Value, selected?: DataItem) => void) | - | When the onChange property is set, the selection box is displayed. The parameter is the current selected value, which is related to the mode property. |
| onFilter | ((text: string) => void \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean)) | - | When the onFilter is not empty, you can filter data by input.If the onFilter returns a function, use this function as a front-end filter.If return undefined, you can do your own backend filtering.support in single selection state. |
| **keygen** | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, parentKey?: string \| number) => string \| number) | index | Auxiliary method for generating key. When it is a function, use the return value of this function. When it is a string, use the data value corresponding to this string. For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id. |
| **renderItem** | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, active?: boolean, id?: string \| number) => ReactNode) | d => d | When \"renderItem\" is a string, it returns DataItem[string]. If it\"s a function, it returns the result of the function. |
| renderResult | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, row: DataItem[]) => ReactNode) | renderItem | The content displayed in the result after selecting, if not set, use renderItem. not show while return null, result is current selected |
| onBlur | ((e?: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void) | - | blur event |
| onFocus | ((e?: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void) | - | focus event |
| placeholder | string | - | placeholder |
| emptyAfterSelect | boolean | true | empty input after select value |
| border | boolean | true | Whether to display border |
| underline | boolean | - | Only display border bottom |
| resultClassName | string \| ((value: DataItem) => string) | - | The className of the selected result content container |
| compressedClassName | string | - | Compressed popover classname |
| hideTag | boolean | false | Hide tag style, by default, the result is displayed in tag mode. After hiding the tag style, the result can be rendered by custom renderResult |
| getComponentRef | ((comp: CascaderRef) => void) \| { current: CascaderRef; } | - | A reference to the binding component, you can call some component methods |
| adjust | boolean | true | Whether to adjust the position of the panel automatically. When the panel is blocked by the window, the position is adjusted automatically |
| virtual | boolean | false | Whether to use virtual list |
| emptyText | ReactNode | - | custom empty copy |
| highlight | boolean | - | Whether to enable highlight feature |
| showParent | boolean | false | Whether to show parent node in the result |
| onClear | (() => void) | - | Triggered when clearing the selected value |
| checkOnFiltered | boolean | false | Check on filtered data. When enabled, checking operations will only apply to filtered results |
| popupClassName | string | - | Custom className for cascader popup |
| popover | PopoverProps[\"position\"] | - | The position where the validation info pop up |
| popoverProps | PopoverProps | - | Vilidate popup properties |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### CascaderRef Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **close** | (e?: MouseEvent) => void | - | Close the drop-down box |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Cascader outermost wrapper element |
| header | Header area (shows selected values / placeholder) |
| popup | Dropdown popup panel |
| list | Each column list container |
| option | List item option |

```tsx
<Cascader
  classNames={{ root: 'my-cascader' }}
  styles={{ root: { border: '1px solid #eee' } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础级联选择器的用法
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic usage of cascader
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Cascader } from 'shineout';

interface DataItem {
  value: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

const data: DataItem[] = [
  {
    value: 'jiangsu',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'nanjing',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'jiangning',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: 'anhui',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'hefei',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'feidong',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
];

export default () => {
  return (
    <div>
      <Cascader
        width={300}
        clearable
        placeholder='Please select city'
        data={data}
        keygen='value'
        renderItem={(n) => `${n?.value}`}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### *    -- Support custom rendering results through `renderResult`

```tsx
/**
 * cn -
 *    -- 通过`renderResult`支持自定义渲染结果
 * en -
 *    -- Support custom rendering results through `renderResult`
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Cascader, TYPE } from 'shineout';

type CascaderProps = TYPE.Cascader.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

interface DataItem {
  value: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

const data: DataItem[] = [
  {
    value: 'jiangsu',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'nanjing',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'jiangning',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: 'anhui',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'hefei',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'feidong',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
];

export default () => {
  const renderResult: CascaderProps['renderResult'] = (node) => {
    return node.value.toLocaleUpperCase();
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <Cascader
        width={300}
        clearable
        placeholder='Please select city'
        data={data}
        keygen='value'
        renderResult={renderResult}
        renderItem={(n) => `${n?.value}`}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### *    -- Cancel the default tag split style through `hideTag`, and customize the rendering to achieve a rich display effect

```tsx
/**
 * cn -
 *    -- 通过`hideTag`取消默认的标签分割样式，配合`renderResult`自定义渲染实现丰富的展示效果
 * en -
 *    -- Cancel the default tag split style through `hideTag`, and customize the rendering to achieve a rich display effect
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Cascader, TYPE } from 'shineout';

type CascaderProps = TYPE.Cascader.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

interface DataItem {
  value: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

const data: DataItem[] = [
  {
    value: 'jiangsu',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'nanjing',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'jiangning',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
  {
    value: 'anhui',
    children: [
      {
        value: 'hefei',
        children: [
          {
            value: 'feidong',
          },
        ],
      },
    ],
  },
];

export default () => {
  const renderResult: CascaderProps['renderResult'] = (node) => {
    return node.value;
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <Cascader
        width={300}
        hideTag
        clearable
        placeholder='Please select city'
        data={data}
        keygen='value'
        onChange={v=>console.log(v)}
        renderResult={renderResult}
        renderItem={(n) => `${n?.value}`}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Checkbox

In a set of data, users can select one or more data through checkboxes

### Checkbox Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| onChange | ((value: T, checked: boolean, raw: T) => void) | - | Value chane callback |
| checked | boolean \| \"indeterminate\" \| ((d: T) => boolean \| \"indeterminate\") | - | If not set, use (value === htmlValue) |
| defaultChecked | boolean \| \"indeterminate\" | - | Default checked status |
| onClick | ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | - | Checkbox click callback |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable checkbox |
| inputRef | Ref<HTMLInputElement> | - | Get input dom |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"label\" \| \"group\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"label\" \| \"group\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| children | ReactNode | - | Content |
| verticalAlign | \"middle\" \| \"top\" | \"middle\" | Vertical align of checkbox indicator |
| htmlValue | any | true | Specifies the result |
| onRawChange | ((value: T, checked: boolean, raw: T) => void) | - | Value chane callback |
| value | any | - | If checked is not set, checked status is value === htmlValue |
| defaultValue | Value | - | Whether to show the input box |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Checkbox.Group Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"label\" \| \"group\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"label\" \| \"group\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| children | ReactNode | - | You can pass in a set of Checkbox |
| renderItem | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => ReactNode) | d => d | When it is a string, return d\\[string]. When it is a function, return the result of the function. |
| prediction | ((value: Value[number], data: DataItem) => boolean) | (val, d) => val===format(d) | By default, the result of the format function is used to compare whether it matches. In some cases (for example, whe an object that returns the original data is updated, an different option with the same value  is generated), the prediction function needs to be used to determine whether match |
| format | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem) => Value[number]) | d => d | Format value. The defaule value is return the original data. When it is a string, the value is fetched from the original data as a key equivalent to (d) => d[format] When it is a function, use its return value |
| separator | string | - | Set with multiple, value will separator by this |
| **keygen** | \| ObjectKey<DataItem>  \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => string \| number)  \| true | index | Key generator When it is true, the data itself is used as the key equivalent to (d => d) When it is a function, use its return value. When it is a string，ues the value of the string.For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id |
| block | boolean | - | The default is horizontal layout and setting the block property can changed it to be vertical layout. |
| data | any[] | - | the data items |
| onChange | ((value: Value) => void) | - | The callback function for changing value |
| value | any | - | In the Form, value is taken over by the Form and the value will be invalid. |
| defaultValue | Value | - | Default value |
| disabled | boolean \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean) | false | When the value is true, disabled all checkboxes; When the value is function, disable the checkbox that this function returns true |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Checkbox outermost wrapper element |
| indicator | Checkbox indicator area (includes the box icon) |
| label | Label text area |
| group | Checkbox.Group container |

```tsx
<Checkbox
  classNames={{ root: 'my-checkbox' }}
  styles={{ root: { padding: '4px 0' } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基本的 Checkbox
 * en - Base
 *    -- Basic Checkbox
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => <Checkbox>Checkbox</Checkbox>;

export default App;
```

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 尺寸
 *    -- 设置 `size` 属性改变组件的尺寸大小, 内置三种尺寸：small、default、large
 * en - Base
 *    -- Set the size property to change the size of the component. There are three built-in sizes: small, default, and large
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center' }}>
    <Checkbox size={'small'}>Checkbox</Checkbox>
    <Checkbox>Checkbox</Checkbox>
    <Checkbox size={'large'}>Checkbox</Checkbox>
  </div>
);

export default App;
```

#### Checked

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 状态
 *    -- checked 有三个值，选中(true)、未选中(false)、半选中('indeterminate')，checked 设置时为受控组件（此示例没有处理 onChange 事件）
 * en - Checked
 *    -- The checked has three values: true(checked), false(not checked), 'indeterminate'(half-checked)
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div>
    <div style={{ marginBottom: 12, lineHeight: 0 }}>
      <Checkbox checked={false}>not checked</Checkbox>
      <Checkbox checked>checked</Checkbox>
      <Checkbox checked='indeterminate'>indeterminate</Checkbox>
    </div>

    <div style={{ lineHeight: 0 }}>
      <Checkbox checked={false} disabled>
        not checked
      </Checkbox>
      <Checkbox checked disabled>
        checked
      </Checkbox>
      <Checkbox checked='indeterminate' disabled>
        indeterminate
      </Checkbox>
    </div>
  </div>
);

export default App;
```
