## Rule

Shineout Form defines a set of data verification mechanisms internally, and configures them through the rules property on the components in Form.

### required Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| message | string | - | Error message displayed when validation fails |

### min Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **min** | number | - | Minimum value limit (minimum numeric value for numbers, minimum length for strings, minimum items for arrays) |
| message | string | - | Error message displayed when validation fails |

### max Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **max** | number | - | Maximum value limit (maximum numeric value for numbers, maximum length for strings, maximum items for arrays) |
| message | string | - | Error message displayed when validation fails |

### range Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **min** | number | - | Minimum value of the range (minimum numeric value for numbers, minimum length for strings, minimum items for arrays) |
| **max** | number | - | Maximum value of the range (maximum numeric value for numbers, maximum length for strings, maximum items for arrays) |
| message | string | - | Error message displayed when validation fails |

### regExp Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **reg** | string \| RegExp | - | Regular expression pattern to match input value, can be RegExp object or regex string |
| message | string | - | Error message displayed when validation fails |

### type Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| message | string | - | Error message displayed when validation fails |

### custom Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| value | any | - | Current field value to be validated |
| formValue | object | - | Complete form data object, useful for cross-field validation |
| callback | ((result: true \| Error) => void) | - | Validation result callback function, pass true for validation success, Error object for validation failure |

### Examples

#### Required validation

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 必填校验
 *    -- 必填校验，验证字段是否已填写。支持三种使用方式：rule.required() 使用默认提示、rule.required('自定义提示') 传入自定义提示、对象形式 { required: true, message: '自定义提示' }
 * en - Required validation
 *    -- Required validation, verifies if the field is filled. Supports three usage methods: rule.required() with default message, rule.required('custom message') with custom message, object form { required: true, message: 'custom message' }
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Form, Input, Rule } from 'shineout';

const rule = Rule();
export default () => {
  return (
    <Form style={{ maxWidth: 500 }}>
      <Form.Item label='name' required>
        <Input name='name' title='name' rules={[rule.required()]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label='age' required>
        <Input name='age' rules={[rule.required('age required')]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label='address' required>
        <Input name='address' rules={[{ required: true, message: 'address required' }]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label=''>
        <Form.Submit>Submit</Form.Submit>
      </Form.Item>
    </Form>
  );
};
```

#### Minimum value validation

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 最小值校验
 *    -- 最小值校验，会根据字段值的数据类型自动判断：如果值是数字类型则验证数值大小，如果值是字符串类型则验证字符串长度，如果值是数组类型则验证数组长度。支持 rule.min(value) 和对象形式 { min: value, message: '自定义提示' }
 * en - Minimum value validation
 *    -- Minimum value validation, automatically determines based on field data type: validates numeric value for number type, string length for string type, array length for array type. Supports rule.min(value) and object form { min: value, message: 'custom message' }
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Form, Input, Rule } from 'shineout';

const rule = Rule();
export default () => {
  return (
    <Form style={{ maxWidth: 500 }}>
      <Form.Item label='name' required>
        <Input name='name' title='name' rules={[rule.required(), rule.min(2)]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label='age' required>
        <Input.Number name='age' title='age' rules={[rule.required(), rule.min(18)]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label='address' required>
        <Input.Number
          name='address'
          title='address'
          rules={[rule.required(), { min: 3, message: 'address must be at least three characters' }]}
        />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label=''>
        <Form.Submit>Submit</Form.Submit>
      </Form.Item>
    </Form>
  );
};
```

#### Maximum value validation

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 最大值校验
 *    -- 最大值校验，会根据字段值的数据类型自动判断：如果值是数字类型则验证数值大小，如果值是字符串类型则验证字符串长度，如果值是数组类型则验证数组长度。支持 rule.max(value) 和对象形式 { max: value, message: '自定义提示' }
 * en - Maximum value validation
 *    -- Maximum value validation, automatically determines based on field data type: validates numeric value for number type, string length for string type, array length for array type. Supports rule.max(value) and object form { max: value, message: 'custom message' }
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Form, Input, Rule } from 'shineout';

const rule = Rule();
export default () => {
  return (
    <Form style={{ maxWidth: 500 }}>
      <Form.Item label='name' required>
        <Input name='name' title='name' rules={[rule.required(), rule.max(5)]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label='age' required>
        <Input.Number name='age' title='age' rules={[rule.required(), rule.max(100)]} />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label='address' required>
        <Input.Number
          name='address'
          title='address'
          rules={[rule.required(), { max: 3, message: 'address must be at least three characters' }]}
        />
      </Form.Item>
      <Form.Item label=''>
        <Form.Submit>Submit</Form.Submit>
      </Form.Item>
    </Form>
  );
};
```

## Select

Select Describe

### Select Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| filterSameChange | boolean | false | onChange is not triggered when two selected values are the same |
| value | any | - | The selected value(s). In Form context, this prop is managed by Form. Note: Do not use undefined or null as meaningful option values - the component will skip processing when value is undefined/null |
| data | DataItem[] | - | Array of option items to display in the dropdown list |
| treeData | Object[] | - | Tree-structured data with nested children. Format: [{children: [...]}] |
| noCache | boolean | false | Disables value-to-data caching. By default, Select caches the mapping between values and data items for performance. When data changes frequently, set this to true to ensure the component always uses the latest data |
| defaultValue | Value | - | Initial value for uncontrolled component |
| separator | string | - | In multi-select mode, joins selected values into a string using this separator |
| multiple | boolean | false | Enable multiple selection mode |
| childrenKey | ObjectKey<DataItem> | \"children\" | Specifies the property name for child nodes in tree data |
| disabled | boolean \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean) | false | When true, disables all options; when function, disables options where function returns true |
| prediction | ((value: Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value, Data: DataItem) => boolean) | (val, d) => val===format(d) | Custom comparison function to determine if a value matches a data item. Solves JavaScript\"s reference equality (===) limitation where objects with identical content but different references are considered unequal |
| format | ((data: DataItem) => Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value) \| ObjectKey<DataItem> | d => d | Formats data item to value. String: extracts property (e.g., \"id\" gets d.id). Function: returns custom value from data item |
| onChange | ((value: Value, data?: DataItem, checked?: boolean) => void) | - | Callback when value changes. Parameters: value (selected value), data (selected data item), checked (selection state) |
| groupBy | ((item: DataItem, index?: number, data?: DataItem[]) => ReactNode) | - | Groups options by returning group name or React component for each item. Parameters: item (current data item to categorize), index (item\"s position in array), data (complete data array for context) |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| status | \"error\" | - | The status of the component |
| innerTitle | ReactNode | - | inner title |
| absolute | boolean \| (() => HTMLElement \| null) | false | When it is true, the pop-up layer of option append into document.body; When it is a function, the return value is used as the popup layer container |
| zIndex | number | 1000 | options z-index should use with absolute |
| emptyText | ReactNode | - | Custom empty state content. When used with renderOptionList, setting emptyText to false will disable this feature. You can render custom empty content in renderOptionList |
| **keygen** | \| ObjectKey<DataItem>  \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => string \| number)  \| true | index | Auxiliary method for generating key. When it is a function, use the return value of this function. When it is a string, use the data value corresponding to this string. For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id. The default value is the array index. For simple arrays (strings/numbers), this works fine. However, for object arrays, you MUST specify a proper keygen to avoid errors. Without a proper keygen, the component will use the entire object as the key, which can cause React rendering errors when renderItem defaults to (d) => d. |
| clearable | boolean | false | Shows a clear icon to remove all selected values when enabled |
| placeholder | string | - | Placeholder text displayed when no option is selected |
| loading | boolean \| ReactNode | false | Loading state indicator. Shows default Spin component when true, or accepts custom loading component |
| header | ReactNode | - | Custom content rendered at the top of the dropdown list |
| footer | ReactNode | - | Custom content rendered at the bottom of the dropdown list |
| renderOptionList | ((list: ReactNode, info: { loading?: ReactNode; empty?: boolean; }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render function for the entire dropdown list content. The first parameter `list` contains the pre-rendered option list (including virtual scrolling, columns layout if configured). The second parameter `info` contains: `loading` - current loading state, which can be boolean (shows default spinner when true) or custom ReactNode. Note: When using this prop with emptyText, set emptyText to false to fully control empty state rendering |
| border | boolean | true | Controls whether to display the select box border |
| underline | boolean | false | Shows only the bottom border for a minimal underline style |
| open | boolean | - | Controls the visibility of the dropdown list programmatically |
| width | string \| number | - | Width of the select input box. Accepts number (px) or string with units |
| height | string \| number | - | Maximum height of the dropdown list. Accepts number (px) or string with units |
| optionWidth | string \| number | 100% | Width of the dropdown list. Accepts number (px) or string with units |
| itemsInView | number | 10 | Maximum number of options rendered at once. Uses virtual scrolling for performance with large datasets. Increase if you need to display more than 10 visible items |
| lineHeight | number \| \"auto\" | 34 | Height of each option item. For fixed-height content, set a number. Use \"auto\" for dynamic heights based on content (may impact performance with large datasets) |
| position | \"auto\" \| \"bottom-left\" \| \"bottom-right\" \| \"top-left\" \| \"top-right\" | auto | Dropdown list placement position. \"auto\" adjusts based on available space |
| columns | number | 1 | Number of columns to display options. Values > 1 enable multi-column layout |
| columnsTitle | ReactNode | - | Title displayed above columns in multi-column multi-select mode |
| showArrow | boolean | true | Shows dropdown arrow icon (single select only) |
| focusSelected | boolean | true | Whether to automatically select the filter text after clicking an option when onFilter is enabled |
| trim | boolean | true | Automatically removes leading/trailing whitespace from input on blur |
| columnWidth | number | 160 | Width of each column in multi-column layout (only when columns > 1) |
| maxLength | number | - | Maximum character length allowed in the filter input |
| autoAdapt | boolean | false | Auto-adjusts dropdown width based on content |
| compressed | boolean \| \"no-repeat\" \| \"hide-popover\" | false | Compresses multiple selected items display. true: dynamically calculates and shows \"+N\" based on container width; \"no-repeat\": same as true but hides already selected items from popover; \"hide-popover\": shows \"+N\" without popover |
| compressedBound | number | - | Fixed number of tags to display before showing \"+N\". When set, always shows this many tags regardless of container width. This provides better performance for large datasets as it avoids expensive DOM calculations |
| compressedClassName | string | - | CSS class name for the compressed items popover |
| renderCompressed | ((options: {  data: DataItem[], onRemove: (item: DataItem) => void }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render function for compressed items display |
| hideCreateOption | boolean | false | Hides the create option from the dropdown list. Press Enter to select the created value directly |
| filterSingleSelect | boolean | false | Auto-selects the only matching option on blur when filtering returns single result |
| defaultExpanded | (string \| number)[] | - | Initially expanded node keys for tree data (uncontrolled) |
| defaultExpandAll | boolean | false | Initially expands all tree nodes (tree data only) |
| expanded | (string \| number)[] | - | Controlled expanded node keys for tree data |
| showHitDescendants | boolean | false | Shows descendant nodes of matched items when filtering tree data |
| convertBr | string \| ((text: string) => string) | \" \" | Converts line breaks when pasting text. String replaces breaks; function transforms the text |
| resultClassName | string \| ((value: DataItem) => string) | - | CSS class name for selected item display. Can be string or function returning class based on value |
| renderItem | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => ReactNode) | d => d | Renders each option in dropdown. String uses property value; function customizes display |
| renderResult | ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => ReactNode) | renderItem | Renders selected items display. Falls back to renderItem if not specified |
| renderUnmatched | ((value: Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render for values that don\"t match any option in data |
| onBlur | ((e: any) => void) | - | Triggered when the select loses focus |
| onFocus | ((e: any) => void) | - | Triggered when the select receives focus |
| onFilter | ((text: string, from?: string) => void \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean)) | - | Enables filtering. Return a function for client-side filtering, or undefined for server-side filtering |
| onCreate | boolean \| ((input: string) => string \| DataItem) | - | Creates new options from input. true uses input as-is; function transforms input into option |
| onEnterExpand | ((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => boolean) | - | Called when Enter key is pressed to expand dropdown. Return false to prevent expansion |
| onCollapse | ((collapse: boolean) => void) | - | Triggered when dropdown opens or closes. Parameter indicates collapsed state |
| onExpand | ((value: (string \| number)[]) => void) | - | Triggered when tree nodes expand/collapse. Receives array of expanded node keys |
| emptyAfterSelect | boolean | - | Clears filter input after selecting an option |
| filterDelay | number | 400 | Debounce delay (ms) for filter input |
| loader | ((key: string \| number, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Loads children dynamically for tree nodes. Nodes without children trigger loader on expand |
| onAdvancedFilter | ((text: string) => (data: DataItem) => boolean) | - | Advanced filter mode allowing toggle between filtered results and original data at current level |
| reFocus | boolean | false | Auto-focuses filter input after selecting when filter and create are enabled |
| adjust | boolean | true | Auto-adjusts dropdown position when blocked by viewport edges |
| onLoadMore | (() => void \| Promise<any>) | - | Triggered when scrolling to bottom of dropdown list for infinite scrolling |
| threshold | number | 1 | Scroll threshold (0-1) for triggering onLoadMore. 1 means bottom of list |
| trigger | \"click\" \| \"hover\" | \"click\" | Trigger mode for opening dropdown |
| highlight | boolean | - | Highlights matching text when filtering |
| preventEnterSelect | boolean | false | Whether to prevent selecting existing options when pressing Enter while onCreate is enabled |
| onClear | (() => void) | - | Triggered when clearing the selected value |
| virtual | boolean | - | Enables virtual scrolling for tree-structured data |
| createOnBlur | boolean | true | Whether to automatically create the option when input loses focus while onCreate is enabled. Only works when there is created data waiting to be added |
| popupClassName | string | - | CSS class name for the dropdown popover |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"popup\" \| \"list\" \| \"option\" \| \"optionInner\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"popup\" \| \"list\" \| \"option\" \| \"optionInner\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| popover | PopoverProps[\"position\"] | - | The position where the validation info pop up |
| popoverProps | PopoverProps | - | Vilidate popup properties |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Select outermost wrapper element |
| header | Header area (shows selected values / placeholder) |
| popup | Dropdown popup panel |
| list | Options list container |
| option | Option item |
| optionInner | Option inner content area |

```tsx
<Select classNames={{ root: 'my-select' }} styles={{ root: { border: '1px solid #eee' } }} />
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- Select 通过`data`属性设置数据源，通过`keygen`属性设置key生成器，通过`renderItem`属性设置渲染函数
 * en - Basic
 *    --
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Select } from 'shineout';


export default () => {
  const data = ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'cyan', 'blue', 'violet', 'pink'];
  return (
    <div>
      <Select width={300} clearable data={data} keygen placeholder='Select Color' />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Multiple

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 多选
 *    -- 设置`multiple`属性允许开启多选功能
 * en - Multiple
 *    -- Set `multiple` to enable multiple selection
 */
import React, { useEffect } from 'react';
import { Select } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string[]>();
  const [selectOpen, setSelectOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const data = ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'cyan', 'blue', 'violet', 'pink'];

  useEffect(() => {
    if(value?.length === 0){
      setSelectOpen(true);
    }
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <div>
      <Select
        width={300}
        multiple
        data={data}
        keygen
        value={value}
        onChange={(v) => setValue(v)}
        placeholder='Select Color'
        clearable
        open={selectOpen}
        onCollapse={(open) => setSelectOpen(open)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Compressed

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 合并选项
 *    -- 多选下设置`compressed`属性，结果不换行，超出折叠显示
 * en - Compressed
 *    -- Set `compressed` to prevent wrapping and will be displayed beyond the fold when multiple
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Select } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const data = ['red', 'orange', 'yellow', 'green', 'cyan', 'blue', 'violet', 'pink'];
  return (
    <div>
      <Select
        width={300}
        defaultValue={data}
        multiple
        onChange={(v) => console.log(v)}
        data={data}
        keygen
        placeholder='Select Color'
        compressed
        clearable
      />
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Slider

Slider is a component that lets users select a value or range of values within a range of values.

### Slider Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| valueTipType | \"always\" \| \"hover\" | \"always\" | The way to show the current value, the default is always displayed |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"track\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"scale\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"track\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"scale\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| autoHide | boolean | false | Automatically hides the current value and scale |
| formatScale | false \| ((value: number, index?: number) => ReactNode) | v => v | Format displayed scale. When it is false, the scale is not displayed. |
| formatValue | false \| ((value: number) => ReactNode) | v => v | Format displayed current value. When it is false, the current value is not displayed. |
| height | number | 200 | height. Only effect when vertical is true |
| onChange | ((value: Value) => void) | - | The callback function when the value is changing. |
| scale | number[] | [0, 100] | Value range. An array whose length is greater than 2. |
| step | number | 1 | Step size. Must be greater than or equal to 0; When it is 0, only the value specified by scale can be selected. |
| value | number \| number[] | - | current value |
| defaultValue | Value | - | default value |
| vertical | boolean | false | Whether to be vertical |
| range | boolean | false | Whether to display double slider |
| disabled | boolean \| ((value: number) => boolean) | false | Disable component. When it is a function, the value is the current value and the return value is whether to disable |
| discrete | boolean | false | Whether to use discrete mode, snapping the indicator to step values during dragging |
| onIncrease | (() => void) | - | Drag over the maximum event |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Slider outermost wrapper element |
| track | Track area |
| indicator | Slider indicator (drag handle) |
| scale | Scale area |

```tsx
<Slider
  classNames={{ root: 'my-slider' }}
  styles={{ root: { padding: '16px 0' } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 最基本的用法
 * en - Base
 *    -- The basic usage
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Slider } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => <Slider defaultValue={50} />;

export default App;
```

#### Range

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 范围选择
 *    -- 设置 range 属性显示为双滑块，输入(返回)值为长度为 2 的数组
 * en - Range
 *    -- Set the range property to display double sliders, and value is an array of length 2
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Slider } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => <Slider range defaultValue={[25, 75]} />;

export default App;
```

#### Scale

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 区间
 *    -- 设置 scale 属性可以自定义区间
 * en - Scale
 *    -- Set the scale property to customize the interval
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Slider } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => <Slider scale={[0, 10, 100, 250, 500, 1000]} />;

export default App;
```

## Switch

Used for switching between two opposing states.

### Switch Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| checked | boolean | - | Checked status，will in control when pass |
| onChange | ((value: boolean) => void) | - | Change callback, Checked means selected status |
| onClick | ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | - | Click callback |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable checkbox |
| inputRef | Ref<HTMLInputElement> | - | Get input dom |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"content\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"indicator\" \| \"content\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| content | [ReactNode, ReactNode] | - | Content with checked and unchecked |
| loading | boolean | false | Loading |
| value | boolean | - | Set while no checked |
| defaultValue | boolean | - | Default value,same type as value |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Switch outermost wrapper (button element) |
| indicator | Toggle indicator (circle button) |
| content | Text content area |

```tsx
<Switch
  classNames={{ root: 'my-switch' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 20 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 最基础的用法
 * en - Base
 *    -- The basic usage
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Switch } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => {
  return <Switch />;
};

export default App;
```

#### Disabled

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 禁用状态
 *    -- 设置 `disabled` 属性, 可以设置禁用状态
 * en - Disabled
 *    -- Set disabled property to disable the Switch
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Switch } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', gap: 24 }}>
      <Switch value={true} disabled />
      <Switch value={false} disabled />
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;
```

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 尺寸
 *    -- 设置 `size` 属性可以调整组件尺寸
 * en - Base
 *    -- Set the size property to adjust the size of the component
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Switch } from 'shineout';

const App: React.FC = () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'row', gap: 24, alignItems: 'center' }}>
      <Switch size={'small'} />
      <Switch />
      <Switch size={'large'} />
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;
```

## Textarea

Users can input or edit text in the text box.

### Textarea Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| value | string | - | DefaultValue and value can be set at the same time and defaultValue will be overridden by value. |
| onChange | ((value: string) => void) | - | The callback function for changing value |

| autosize | boolean | false | Whether the height changes automatically with the content |

| onClick | MouseEventHandler<Element> | - | Callback function for click |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disabled |
| textareaRef | Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement> | - | Get textarea dom |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |

| status | \"error\" | - | The status of the component |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"textarea\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"textarea\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |

| border | boolean | true | Whether to display border |

| clearable | boolean | false | Whether to clear the value |
| showClear | boolean | false | Whether to show the clear button when there is a value |

| maxHeight | string \| number | - | the maxHeight of the textarea, scroll bars appear after more than |
| trim | boolean | false | When trim is true, blank characters are automatically deleted when lose focus |
| renderFooter | ((value?: string) => ReactNode) | - | Render textarea footer |
| width | string \| number | - | Input width |
| delay | number | - | User input triggers the onChange and to check interval, unit: ms |
| popover | PopoverProps[\"position\"] | - | The position where the validation info pop up |
| popoverProps | PopoverProps | - | Vilidate popup properties |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Semantic DOM

|-----|-------------|

#### Size

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 尺寸
 *    -- 提供了三种尺寸 `small | default | large`
 * en - Size
 *    -- There are three sizes: small, default, and large
 */

const style: React.CSSProperties = { width: 120, marginInlineEnd: 24 };

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <div>
    <Textarea size='small' rows={3} style={style} placeholder='small size' />
    <Textarea style={style} rows={3} placeholder='default size' />
    <Textarea size='large' rows={3} style={style} placeholder='large size' />
  </div>
);

export default App;
```

## Transfer

Users can input or edit text in the text box.

### Transfer Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| value | Value | - | The set of values displayed in the box data on the right |
| **data** | DataItem[] | index | Data source |
| selectedKeys | (string \| number)[] | - | The checked list, the checked values ​​use the results of keygen |
| defaultSelectedKeys | (string \| number)[] | - | Default checked list |
| defaultValue | Value | - | Default value |
| format | ((data: DataItem) => Value[number]) \| ObjectKey<DataItem> | d => d | Format value. The defaule value is return the original data. When it is a string, the value is fetched from the original data as a key equivalent to (d) => d[format] When it is a function, use its return value |
| keygen | \| ObjectKey<DataItem>  \| ((data: DataItem, index?: number) => string \| number)  \| true | index | Generate a auxiliary method for each key If not filled, index will be used(not recommended,there may be problems with more than 10 data) When it is a function, use its return value. When it is a string，ues the value of the string.For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id |
| simple | boolean | false | Whether to enable simple mode |
| disabled | boolean \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean) | - | When the value is true, disabled all checkboxes; When the value is function, disable the checkbox that this function returns true |
| prediction | ((value: Value[number], Data: DataItem) => boolean) | - | By default, the result of the format function is used to compare whether it matches. In some cases (for example, whe an object that returns the original data is updated, an different option with the same value  is generated), the prediction function needs to be used to determine whether match |
| onChange | ((value: Value, currentData: DataItem \| DataItem[], isTarget: boolean) => void) | - | Change callback,Parameter is the selected value |
| onFilter | ((text: string, data: DataItem, isSource: boolean) => boolean) | - | Filter function, parameters are: input text, data, whether it is the data on the left |
| onSearch | ((text: string, isSource: boolean) => void) | - | Search event |
| onSelectChange | ((sourceKeys: (string \| number)[], targetKeys?: (string \| number)[]) => void) \| ((selectKeys: (string \| number)[]) => void) | - | Select event |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"list\" \| \"item\" \| \"operations\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"list\" \| \"item\" \| \"operations\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| listHeight | number | 186 | List Height |
| lineHeight | number | 34 | List row height |
| renderItem | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem) => ReactNode) | d => d | When it is a string, return d[string] When it is a function, return the result of the function |
| itemClass | string | - | The class name of the item |
| empty | ReactNode | - | ContentLess display |
| rowsInView | number | 20 | Number of data loaded at one time |
| listClassName | string | - | The class name of the list |
| listStyle | CSSProperties | - | The style of the list |
| titles | [ReactNode, ReactNode] | - | Title on both sides, order from left to right |
| footers | [ReactNode, ReactNode] | - | Bottom element, order from left to right |
| operations | [ReactNode, ReactNode] | - | Operational elements, the order is from top to bottom |
| operationIcon | boolean | true | Whether to display the icon of the action button |
| loading | boolean \| [boolean, boolean] | - | Loading, if you need the loading status to be inconsistent on both sides, you need to pass in an array |
| searchPlaceholder | string \| [string, string] | - | The placeholder of the search box |
| renderFilter | ((filterProps: FilterProps) => ReactNode) | - | Custom filter rendering |
| children | ((props: { onSelected: ((string \| number)[]) => void; direction: \"left\" \| \"right\"; selectedKeys: (string \| number)[]; value: Value; filterText: string; }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render content |
| equalPanelWidth | boolean | - | Panel equal distribution container width |
| highlight | boolean | - | Whether to enable highlight feature |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Transfer outermost wrapper element |
| header | Panel header area (includes select-all + title) |
| list | List container |
| item | Individual list item |
| operations | Middle operation buttons area |

```tsx
<Transfer
  classNames={{ root: 'my-transfer' }}
  styles={{ root: { border: '1px solid #eee' } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础 Transfer 使用
 * en - Base
 *    -- Base Transfer
 */
import { Transfer } from 'shineout';

const data: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  data.push({
    id: `id-${i}`,
    name: `name-${i + 1}`,
  });
}

export default () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ width: 600 }}>
      <Transfer data={data} keygen='id' listHeight={232} renderItem='name'></Transfer>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Size

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 尺寸
 *    -- 内置三种尺寸，small、default、large
 * en - Size
 *    -- There are three built-in sizes, small, default, and large
 */
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Transfer, Radio } from 'shineout';

const data: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];
const radios = ['small', 'default', 'large'];

for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  data.push({
    id: `id-${i}`,
    name: `name-${i + 1}`,
  });
}

export default () => {
  const [radio, setRadio] = useState<'small' | 'default' | 'large'>('default');

  return (
    <div>
      <Radio.Group
        style={{ marginBottom: 24 }}
        keygen
        value={radio}
        onChange={setRadio}
        data={radios}
      ></Radio.Group>
      <Transfer data={data} size={radio} keygen='id' listHeight={232} renderItem='name'></Transfer>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Simple

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 简单模式
 *    -- 通过开启 `simple` 属性，可以使用简单模式
 *    -- 简单模式下`selectedKeys`和`onSelectChange`不生效
 * en - Simple
 *    -- By turning on the `simple` property, you can use the simple mode. In simple mode, `selectKeys` and `onSelectChange` are not valid
 *    -- In simple mode, `selectKeys` and `onSelectChange` are not valid
 */
import { Transfer } from 'shineout';

const data: { id: string; name: string }[] = [];

for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  data.push({
    id: `id-${i}`,
    name: `name-${i + 1}`,
  });
}

export default () => {
  return (
    <Transfer
      simple
      data={data}
      defaultValue={['id-7', 'id-8', 'id-9']}
      keygen='id'
      format='id'
      listHeight={232}
      renderItem='name'
    ></Transfer>
  );
};
```

---

## TreeSelect

Displays hierarchical information in a clear structure, making it easy for users to find the corresponding nodes and data according to the relationship between the data.

### TreeSelect Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | There are three built-in size: small、default、large. |
| status | \"error\" | - | The status of the component |
| innerTitle | ReactNode | - | inner title |
| filterSameChange | boolean | false | onChange is not triggered when two selected values are the same |
| absolute | boolean \| (() => HTMLElement \| null) | false | When it is true, the pop-up layer of option append into document.body; When it is a function, the return value is used as the popup layer container |
| zIndex | number | 1000 | options z-index should use with absolute |
| actionOnClick | ActionOnClick \| ActionOnClick[] | - | The operation when clicking the node to expand: \"expand\" expand the node, \"check\" check the checkbox |
| value | Value | - | Selected key (controlled), must be an array in multiple selection. Note: Do not use undefined and null as meaningful option values. When the value type is undefined and null, the component will not process data and rendering |
| defaultValue | Value | - | Initial value |
| data | DataItem[] | [] | data source |
| expanded | (string \| number)[] | - | Expanded node |
| defaultExpanded | (string \| number)[] | - | default expanded nodes |
| defaultExpandAll | boolean | false | Expand all node, only in can be use in treeData |
| disabled | boolean \| ((item: DataItem) => boolean) \| {  disabled: (data: DataItem) => boolean, isRealtime: boolean } | false | When it is true, all nodes disable the selection; when it is a function, it determines whether it is disabled according to the return result of the function. |
| **keygen** | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, parentKey: string \| number) => string \| number) | - | Auxiliary method for generating key. When it is a function, use the return value of this function. When it is a string, use the data value corresponding to this string. For example, \"id\" is the same thing as (d) => d.id |
| childrenKey | ObjectKey<DataItem> | \"children\" | specify the name of the subdata |
| mode | 0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 | 1 | mode 0: Returns only the fully selected node including the parent node. 1: Returns all selected nodes and semi-selected nodes. 2: Return only the selected child nodes. 3: If the parent node is full selected, only return the parent node. 4: What you choose is what you get. |
| unmatch | boolean | true | Render unmatch value |
| onExpand | ((value: (string \| number)[]) => void) | - | Expand event |
| sortBySelect | boolean | false | When enabled in multi-select mode, the value array is sorted by selection order instead of tree structure order |
| virtual | boolean | - | Virtual list |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"popup\" \| \"list\" \| \"option\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"header\" \| \"popup\" \| \"list\" \| \"option\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| noCache | boolean | false | Data cache, if data change asynchronously, better set true |
| emptyText | ReactNode | - | Custom empty state content. When used with renderOptionList, setting emptyText to false will disable this feature. You can render custom empty content in renderOptionList |
| loading | boolean \| ReactNode | false | When it is true, a default [Spin](/components/Spin) component will be displayed, a custom loading icon can be passed in to replace. |
| placeholder | string | - | placeholder when value is empty |
| compressedBound | number | - | when compressed is True,the comptessedBound can limit the numbers of multiple selected item\"s label |
| compressedClassName | string | - | Compressed popover classname |
| clearable | boolean | false | If clearable is true, show clear value icon |
| renderUnmatched | ((data: Value extends (infer U)[] ? U : Value) => ReactNode) | - | ender unmatched value |
| getComponentRef | ((ref: ComponentRef<DataItem, Value>) => void) \| { current?: ComponentRef<DataItem, Value>; } | - | Some methods of getting components Currently only support getDataByValue |
| onFilter | ((text: string, from?: string) => void \| ((data: DataItem) => boolean)) | - | When the onFilter is not empty, you can filter data by input. If the onFilter returns a function, use this function as a front-end filter. If return undefined, you can do your own backend filtering |
| empty | ReactNode | - | Placeholder content when there is no data |
| multiple | boolean | false | if it is true, it will be multiple selection |
| onBlur | ((e?: any) => void) | - | callback function of blur event |
| onFocus | ((e?: any) => void) | - | callback function of focus event |
| renderResult | ((data: DataItem) => ReactNode) | renderItem | The content displayed in the result after selecting, if not set, use renderItem. not show while return null, result is current selected |
| height | number | 250 | The height of list |
| onCollapse | ((collapse: boolean) => void) | - | option collapse callback |
| showHitDescendants | boolean | false | Whether to show the descendant nodes of the hit node after filtering |
| position | \"auto\" \| \"bottom-left\" \| \"top-left\" | - | Popup Position |
| onEnterExpand | ((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => boolean) | - | Expand option list while enter press |
| onChange | ((value: Value, selected?: DataItem \| {  IS_NOT_MATCHED_VALUE: boolean, value: any }, path?: (string \| number)[]) => void) | - | value is your picker now |
| onChangeAddition | ((params: { current?: DataItem \| UnMatchedData \| (DataItem \| UnMatchedData)[]; checked?: 0 \| 1 \| 2; data?: DataItem \| UnMatchedData \| (DataItem \| UnMatchedData)[] \| null; }) => void) | - | onChange additional parameters (current is the data of the clicked node, data is the currently selected data, checked is whether it is selected or canceled in the multi-select state) |
| compressed | boolean \| \"no-repeat\" \| \"hide-popover\" | false | Merges selected values; the repeat value will not appear in the Popover when it is\"no-repeat\". |
| open | boolean | - | Set visible of datepicker popup |
| line | boolean | false | Whether show line |
| width | string \| number | - | Input width |
| underline | boolean | false | Only display border bottom |
| border | boolean | false | Whether to display border |
| showArrow | boolean | true | Whether to display arrow |
| focusSelected | boolean | true | Whether to automatically select the filter text after clicking an option when onFilter is enabled |
| resultClassName | string \| ((value: DataItem) => string) | - | The className of the selected result content container |
| loader | ((key: string \| number, data: DataItem) => void) | - | Dynamically load nodes |
| parentClickExpand | boolean | false | Expand by click parent node |
| trim | boolean | true | When trim is true, blank characters are automatically deleted when lose focus |
| **renderItem** | ObjectKey<DataItem> \| ((data: DataItem, expanded: boolean, active: boolean, id: string \| number) => ReactNode) | index | When it is a string, return d[string]. When it is a function, return the result of the function |
| onAdvancedFilter | ((text: string) => (data: DataItem) => boolean) | - | In the advanced filter mode, you can switch between the filter results and the original data for the current level by pressing the button |
| adjust | boolean | true | Whether to adjust the position of the panel automatically. When the panel is blocked by the window, the position is adjusted automatically |
| filterDelay | number | 400 | ms. The delay of user input triggering filter events |
| reFocus | boolean | false | There are onFilter and onCreate, select Option, automatically focus Input |
| contentClass | string \| ((data: DataItem) => string) | - | Class name of content |
| renderCompressed | ((options: {  data: DataItem[], onRemove: (item: DataItem) => void }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render compressed content |
| highlight | boolean | - | Whether to enable highlight feature |
| onClear | (() => void) | - | Triggered when clearing the selected value |
| checkOnFiltered | boolean | false | Check on filtered data. When enabled, checking operations will only apply to filtered results |
| popupclassName | string | - | Popup class name |
| renderOptionList | ((list: ReactNode, info: { empty?: boolean; }) => ReactNode) | - | Custom render function for the entire dropdown list content. The parameter `list` contains the pre-rendered option list (including virtual scrolling if configured). Note: When using this prop with emptyText, setting emptyText to false will disable this feature. You can render custom empty content in renderOptionList |
| popover | PopoverProps[\"position\"] | - | The position where the validation info pop up |
| popoverProps | PopoverProps | - | Vilidate popup properties |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### TreeSelectRef Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **getDataByValues** | (values: Value) => Value extends any[] ? (DataItem \| UnMatchedData)[] : DataItem \| UnMatchedData | - | Get the data corresponding to the value |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | TreeSelect outermost wrapper element |
| header | Header area (shows selected values / placeholder) |
| popup | Dropdown popup panel |
| list | Tree list container |
| option | Tree node option |

```tsx
<TreeSelect
  classNames={{ root: 'my-tree-select' }}
  styles={{ root: { border: '1px solid #eee' } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础的 TreeSelect 用法
 *    -- 默认`childrenKey`属性值为 'children'
 *    -- 单选模式下 TreeSelect 遵循`mode`属性规则，详见mode属性说明
 * en - Basic
 *    -- Basic usage of TreeSelect
 *    -- The default value of the `childrenKey` property is 'children'
 *    -- In single selection `mode`, TreeSelect follows the mode attribute rules, see the mode attribute description for details
 */
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { TreeSelect, TYPE } from 'shineout';

interface DataItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

type TreeSelectProps = TYPE.TreeSelect.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

const data: DataItem[] = [
  {
    id: '1',
    title: '1',
    children: [
      {
        id: '1-1',
        title: '1-1',
        children: [
          { id: '1-1-1', title: '1-1-1' },
          { id: '1-1-2', title: '1-1-2' },
        ],
      },
      { id: '1-2', title: '1-2' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    title: '2',
    children: [
      { id: '2-1', title: '2-1' },
      { id: '2-2', title: '2-2' },
    ],
  },
  { id: '3', title: '3', children: [{ id: '3-1', title: '3-1' }] },
];

export default () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<TreeSelectProps['value']>([]);

  const handleChange: TreeSelectProps['onChange'] = (v) => {
    setValue(v);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <TreeSelect
        width={300}
        value={value}
        onChange={handleChange}
        clearable
        keygen='id'
        renderItem={(node) => `node ${node.title}`}
        data={data}
        placeholder='Please select content'
      ></TreeSelect>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Multiple

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 多选
 *    -- 开启`multiple`属性后，可以选择多个节点
 *    -- 注意，开启多选模式后，最终数据结果遵循`mode`属性规则，详见mode属性说明
 * en - Multiple
 *    -- Set `multiple` to true, you can select multiple nodes
 */
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { TreeSelect, TYPE } from 'shineout';

interface DataItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

type TreeSelectProps = TYPE.TreeSelect.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

const data: DataItem[] = [
  {
    id: '1',
    title: '1',
    children: [
      {
        id: '1-1',
        title: '1-1',
        children: [
          { id: '1-1-1', title: '1-1-1' },
          { id: '1-1-2', title: '1-1-2' },
        ],
      },
      { id: '1-2', title: '1-2' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    title: '2',
    children: [
      { id: '2-1', title: '2-1' },
      { id: '2-2', title: '2-2' },
    ],
  },
  { id: '3', title: '3', children: [{ id: '3-1', title: '3-1' }] },
];

export default () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<TreeSelectProps['value']>([]);

  const handleChange: TreeSelectProps['onChange'] = (v) => {
    setValue(v);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <TreeSelect
        multiple
        width={300}
        value={value}
        onChange={handleChange}
        clearable
        keygen='id'
        renderItem={(node) => `node ${node.title}`}
        data={data}
        placeholder='Please select content'
      ></TreeSelect>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Compressed

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 合并选项
 *    -- 使用`compressed`属性可以合并选中结果
 * en - Compressed
 *    -- Set `compressed` to true, you can merge the selected results
 */
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { TreeSelect, TYPE } from 'shineout';

interface DataItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  children?: DataItem[];
}

type TreeSelectProps = TYPE.TreeSelect.Props<DataItem, string[]>;

const data: DataItem[] = [
  {
    id: '1',
    title: '1',
    children: [
      {
        id: '1-1',
        title: '1-1',
        children: [
          { id: '1-1-1', title: '1-1-1' },
          { id: '1-1-2', title: '1-1-2' },
        ],
      },
      { id: '1-2', title: '1-2' },
    ],
  },
  {
    id: '2',
    title: '2',
    children: [
      { id: '2-1', title: '2-1' },
      { id: '2-2', title: '2-2' },
    ],
  },
  { id: '3', title: '3', children: [{ id: '3-1', title: '3-1' }] },
];

export default () => {
  const [value, setValue] = useState<TreeSelectProps['value']>(["1-1-1","1-1-2","1-1","1-2","1","2-1","2-2","2","3-1","3"]);

  const handleChange: TreeSelectProps['onChange'] = (v) => {
    setValue(v);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      <TreeSelect
        multiple
        width={300}
        value={value}
        compressed
        onChange={handleChange}
        clearable
        keygen='id'
        renderItem={(node) => `node ${node.title}`}
        data={data}
        placeholder='Please select content'
      ></TreeSelect>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## Upload

Users can transfer files or submit the corresponding content (The example server on this page is limited to 10 KB, and files larger than this limit will fail to upload)

### Upload Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| onChange | ((value: T[]) => void) | - | The callback function when the value is changing(Upload successfully, delete). values: Array, the value is the onSuccess returns |
| value | any[] | - | value |
| accept | string | - | The type of the upload file, same as the standard,See details [accept](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/file#accept) |
| action | string \| ((file: File) => string) | - | The address for uploading |
| beforeUpload | ((file: File) => Promise<any>) | - | The callback of before upload |
| validatorHandle | boolean \| ((error: any, file: File) => boolean) | true | Whether to handle the case of validation failure, if a function is provided, it is judged by the return value of the function. |
| headers | object | - | Request headers |
| htmlName | string | - | The filename received by the server. If it is not filled in, use the name. |
| limit | number | 100 | Maximum number of uploaded files |
| responseType | XMLHttpRequestResponseType | - | set xhr.responseType |
| request | (options: UploadOptions) => Xhr \| void | - | Custom upload method. options: the options of upload |
| params | object | - | params |
| withCredentials | boolean | false | Whether to take the cookie |
| onStart | ((file: File) => void) | - | callback when start |
| onProgress | false \| ((fileInfo: FileRecord) => any) | - | onProgress |
| onSuccess | ((res: any, file: File, data?: any, xhr?: XhrResult) => ValueItem \| Error) | - | onSuccess |
| onHttpError | ((xhr: XhrResult, file: File) => string) | - | onHttpError callback |
| filesFilter | ((fileList: File[]) => File[]) | - | Filter after file selection, users can customize the list of files that need to be uploaded eventually. Need to return a new file list |
| validator | Validator | - | Check file before uploading |
| forceAccept | string | - | After disabled the file type filtering provided by accept, it is mandatory to check the file type, value same as accept |
| onErrorRemove | ((xhr: XhrResult, file: File, fileInfo?: any) => void) | - | remove update failed callback |
| beforeCancel | ((file: FileRecord) => void) | - | The callback function before cancel upload file. |
| recoverAble | boolean | false | Whether to recover deleted values. |
| disabled | boolean | false | is disabled |
| beforeRemove | ((value: ValueItem) => Promise<any>) | - | callback before remove |
| ignorePreview | boolean | - | ignore image preview |
| functionalOnChange | boolean | false | After setting to true, the onChange parameter of the component will return a function, that is, the setState of the callback function |
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"handler\" \| \"item\", string>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"handler\" \| \"item\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM styles for internal nodes. |
| showUploadList | boolean | true | show upload list |
| drop | boolean | false | drop to update |
| multiple | boolean | false | multiple file |
| children | ReactNode | - | Upload placeholder |
| webkitdirectory | string \| boolean | - | The same as the native webkitdirectory tag |
| defaultValue | T[] | - | default value |
| renderResult | ((data: any) => ReactNode) | a => a | Display results |
| canDelete | boolean \| ((item: T, index: number) => boolean) | true | Can the file be deleted |
| customResult | ((options: { value: any; files: any; onValueRemove: (index: number) => void; onFileRemove: (id: string) => void; filesInstances: ReactNode; valueInstances: ReactNode; recoverValue: any; onValueRecover: (index: number) => void; handler: ReactNode; }) => ReactNode) | - | custom Result component |
| forceAcceptErrorMsg | string | - | Custom error prompt after forceAccept type verification fails |
| removeConfirm | string \| PopoverConfirmProps | - | Confirmation before deletion |
| listType | \"text\" \| \"image\" | \"text\" | The type of display |
| hideHandler | boolean | false | Whether to hide the trigger. Note that turning on this property will not affect the handler returned in customResult, only the default trigger will be hidden |
| beforeDrop | ((e: DragEvent<Element>) => Promise<FileList>) | - | Callback before dropping. Allow users to handle drag events and read file lists by themselves, and require the return value to be of type Promise<FileList> |
| leftHandler | boolean | false | Add image view is displayed on the left |
| imageStyle | CSSProperties | {width: 80, height: 80} | The style of the image |
| renderContent | ((res: any, item: T, index: number, values: T[]) => ReactNode) | - | Custom rendering of uploaded images |
| onPreview | ((url: string, value: T, index: number, values: T[], fun: { preview: () => void; }) => void) | - | how to preview the image |
| name | Name | - | The key access data in the Form |
| beforeChange | ((value: T) => void \| T) | - | The callback before the value is changed, when the return value is not empty, it will be used as the new value of the component |
| reserveAble | boolean | - | Controls whether to preserve field data when component unmounts. Set to true to keep data in form state after component removal. Useful for dynamic forms, conditional fields, or when temporarily hiding/showing fields while preserving their values |
| rules | RuleItem[] | - | Array of validation rules to validate field value. Each rule can be a function, regular expression, or rule object. Supports built-in rules (required, email, etc.) and custom validation logic. See [Rule](/components/rule) for detailed configuration |
| onError | ((error?: Error) => void) | - | Callback function triggered when validation completes. Receives validation error (if any) as parameter. Useful for custom error handling, logging validation results, or triggering side effects based on validation state |
| bind | string[] | - | Array of field names that should be re-validated when current field\"s value changes. Enables field linkage validation for dependent fields. Commonly used in scenarios like password confirmation, related dropdown selections, or interdependent form calculations |
| clearToUndefined | boolean | - | If set to true, the form will not automatically delete the data after the component is uninstalled |
| validateTrigger | \"change\" \| \"change-blur\" | - | Controls when to trigger field validation. If not set, inherits from Form\"s validateTrigger. \"change\" triggers validation on value change only, \"change-blur\" triggers validation on both value change and blur. Overrides Form\"s global validateTrigger setting for this specific field |

### Upload.Image Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| width | string \| number | 80 | Upload image container width |
| height | string \| number | 80 | Upload image container height |

### Upload.Button Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| size | \"small\" \| \"large\" \| \"default\" | \"default\" | The size of the button |
| type | \| \"default\"  \| \"primary\"  \| \"secondary\"  \| \"danger\"  \| \"warning\"  \| \"success\"  \| \"link\" | \"default\" | The type of the button |
| mode | \"text\" \| \"outline\" \| \"dashed\" | - | The mode of the button |
| placeholder | ReactNode | - | Button default content |
| loading | ReactNode | - | content of uploading, will have spin if a string |

### UploadOptions Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| **url** | string | - | The upload address can be obtained from action |
| **name** | string | - | key of formData |
| **withCredentials** | boolean | false | Whether to take the cookie |
| **responseType** | XMLHttpRequestResponseType | - | same as responseType in props |
| **file** | File | - | incoming file |
| headers | object | - | request header information |
| **onError** | (xhr: XhrResult) => void | - | onError callback |
| **onLoad** | (xhr: XhrResult) => void | - | onLoad |
| **onProgress** | (event: ProgressEvent<EventTarget>, msg?: string) => any | - | onProgress |
| onStart | ((file: File) => void) | - | onStart |
| onSuccess | ((res: any, file: File, data?: any, xhr?: XhrResult) => Error \| T) | - | onSuccess |
| params | object | - | params |

### Validator Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| customValidator | ((file: File) => void \| Promise<any> \| Error) | - | custom validator |
| ext | ((ext: string) => void \| Promise<any> \| Error) | - | Judge the file extension, return the Error when the verification fails. |
| imageSize | (image: { width: number; height: number; }) => void \| Error | - | It is only valid for Image to determine the size of images and return the Error when the verification fails. |
| size | ((size: number) => void \| Promise<any> \| Error) | - | Judge the size of the file and return the Error when the verification fails. |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Upload outermost wrapper element |
| handler | Upload trigger area (button / image add box) |
| item | Uploaded file result item |

```tsx
<Upload
  classNames={{ root: 'my-upload' }}
  styles={{ root: { gap: 12 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Base

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 基础的文件上传, onSuccess 的返回值会作为 value 传给 onChange
 * en - Base
 *    -- Basic usage for uploading file, the onSuccess's returns will be the onChange params

 */
import React from 'react';
import { Button, Upload } from 'shineout';
import { UploadIcon } from './static/icon';


const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string[]>([]);

  return (
    <Upload
      action='//jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts'
      accept='image/*'
      value={value}
      htmlName='file'
      onSuccess={(_res, file) => file.name}
      onChange={(v) => {
        setValue(v);
      }}
      style={{ width: 400 }}
    >
      <Button mode={'outline'}>
        <UploadIcon style={{ marginInlineEnd: 4 }} />
        Upload file
      </Button>
    </Upload>
  );
};
export default App;
```

#### Upload Image

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 上传图片
 *    -- 使用 Upload.Image 处理带预览的图片上
 * en - Upload Image
 *    -- Basic usage for uploading file, the onSuccess's returns will be the onChange params

 */
import React from 'react';
import { Upload } from 'shineout';
import { mockRquest } from './request';

const App: React.FC = () => {
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState<string[]>([]);

  return (
    <Upload.Image
      request={mockRquest({
        uploadTime: 5000,
        success: true,
      })}
      accept='image/*'
      value={value}
      htmlName='file'
      recoverAble
      leftHandler
      removeConfirm='Are you sure to delete it ?'
      limit={3}
      onSuccess={(_res, filem, data) => {
        return data;
      }}
      onChange={(v) => {
        setValue(v);
      }}
    />
  );
};
export default App;
```

#### Button

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 按钮上传
 *    -- 使用 Upload.Button 展示单个文件的上传进度
 * en - Button
 *    -- Use Upload.Button to show the upload progress of individual files
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Upload } from 'shineout';
import { mockRquest } from './request';

const App: React.FC = () => {

  return (
  <Upload.Button
    type={'primary'}
    request={mockRquest({
      uploadTime: 5000,
      success: true
    })}
    name='file'
    onSuccess={(_res, file) => file.name}
    loading='Uploading...'
    placeholder='Click to upload'
  />
)
};

export default App;
```

## Alert

Alert Describe

### Alert Props

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| className | string | - | Custom class name |
| style | CSSProperties | - | Custom style |
| type | \"success\" \| \"info\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" \| \"confirmwarning\" \| \"error\" | \"warning | Alert type |
| closeItem | ReactNode | - | Custom close button |
| icon | ReactNode | - | When the type is true, the status icon is displayed according to the type property. If you need to display a custom icon, pass in ReactElement |
| iconSize | number | 14 | The size for icon |
| iconClassName | string | - | The ClassName of the icon |
| title | ReactNode | - | The title of the alert |
| titleStyle | CSSProperties | - | The style of the title |
| titleClassName | string | - | The className of the title |
| closable | boolean \| \"only\" | - | Whether to display the close button, when set to only, only the close button is displayed |
| onClose | ((e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | - | Close event |
| bordered | boolean | true | Whether to display the border |
| children | ReactNode | - | Content, text or react component |
| classNames | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"icon\" \| \"title\" \| \"content\" \| \"close\", string \| ((info: {  type: \"success\" \| \"info\" \| \"warning\" \| \"danger\" }) => string)>> | - | Semantic DOM classNames for internal nodes (root / icon / title / content / close).\nAccepts a static string or a function receiving a state snapshot. |
| styles | Partial<Record<\"root\" \| \"icon\" \| \"title\" \| \"content\" \| \"close\", CSSProperties>> | - | Semantic DOM inline styles for internal nodes (root / icon / title / content / close). |

### Semantic DOM

| Key | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| root | Outermost wrapper element (equivalent to className) |
| icon | Icon area |
| title | Title element |
| content | Content text area |
| close | Close button |

```tsx
<Alert
  classNames={{ root: 'my-alert' }}
  styles={{ root: { borderRadius: 8 } }}
/>
```

### Examples

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 基本用法
 *    -- 提示框基本用法，在页面内用于展示重要提示信息
 * en - Basic
 *    -- The basic usage of Alert, used to display important prompt information in the page
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Alert } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <Alert icon type='info'>
      This is a line of important text for alerting purposes
    </Alert>
  );
};
```

#### Type

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 不同类型
 *    -- 通过设置 `type` 属性切换不同的提示框类型，支持 4 种不同的类型：`success`、`info`、`warning`、`danger`
 * en - Type
 *    -- Set the `type` property to switch between different types of alert boxes. Support 4 different types: `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`
 */
import React from 'react';
import { Alert } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 24 }}>
      <Alert icon type='info' style={{ width: 'calc(50% - 16px)' }}>
        This is informative text.
      </Alert>
      <Alert icon type='success' style={{ width: 'calc(50% - 16px)' }}>
        This is success text.
      </Alert>
      <Alert icon type='warning' style={{ width: 'calc(50% - 16px)' }}>
        This is warning text.
      </Alert>
      <Alert icon type='danger' style={{ width: 'calc(50% - 16px)' }}>
        This is danger text.
      </Alert>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### Basic

```tsx
/**
 * cn - 允许关闭
 *    -- 通过设置 `closable` 属性可以展示关闭按钮。通过 `onClose` 属性可以设置关闭回调函数
 *    -- 注意 `onClose` 属性未来不再支持 boolean 类型，`hideClose` 属性即将弃用，请使用 `closable`
 * en - Basic
 *    -- The basic usage of Alert, used to display important prompt information in the page
 */
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Button } from 'shineout';

export default () => {
  const [reset, setReset] = useState(true);
  const handleReset = () => {
    setReset(true);
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      setReset(false);
    }, 300);
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {!reset && (
        <Button onClick={handleReset} mode='text' type='primary'>
          重置
        </Button>
      )}
      {reset && (
        <Alert icon closable type='info' onClose={handleClose}>
          This is informative text.
        </Alert>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
```
